body:
It’s on us to turn up the heat and public pressure before the postal service is reduced to rubble. |
#
Remember Louis DeJoy, folks? Donald Trump hand-picked him for Postmaster General after being one of his wealthiest campaign donors. He’s the guy who slowed down mail delivery, cut pay for thousands of postal workers, canceled employee overtime, decommissioned mail-sorting machines, removed drop boxes, and more. Yikes. Here’s the real kicker: President Biden can’t directly remove him from the United States Postal Service. And so far, DeJoy hasn’t budged. **It’s on us to turn up the heat and public pressure before the postal service is reduced to rubble.** **[Will you sign my petition to demand DeJoy’s resignation from the postal service? | | Peter,
---
|
* IMPORTANT Education Hearing Monday, July 31st!
* Give Parents Control over their Children’s Education
* 🚨 Senator Linehan & Nebraska Students Need Your Help
* We Are Seeking Your Input in Preparing the 2024 Legislative Plan

---
|
---
|
## **IMPORTANT Education Hearing _Monday, July 31st_!**
#### **State Capitol
Location: Room 1525
Time: 1:30 PM**
---
| **The Democrats continue to organize to control the education of YOUR children. Their social media posts ignite their base to _“Stand With Us Against this Fascist Agenda!”_ at the Capitol on Monday. You have to ask yourself what would make liberals so impassioned to rally on Monday at 1:30pm at the Capitol?!?

The Truth. When liberals rally, it's to stop the TRUTH!
See below...** **[https://nebraskalegislature.gov/calendar/hearings.php?day=2023-07-31](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=22f3a0ff2d&e=25844e23a8)**
* **“Interim Study Relating to to Parental Involvement in Public Schools”**
* **“Interim study to examine the use of federal funds from the federal Elementary and Secondary School Emergency Relief Fund and the use of the Launch Nebraska website”**
* **“Interim study related to social-emotional learning in the classroom”**

**The Republican Party of Nebraska has vowed to stand for children, parental rights over their children, and a much stronger educational system built on the proficiency of reading, writing, math, & science. ****Republicans, we CARE for students and teachers. We need to show teachers how much we support them and their love of educating our children.

The Democrats really believe that ****Fascism is YOU having rights over your children’s education, input on the direction of taxpayer money, and discussing the agendas being taught in curriculum.

This is NOT fascism, this is common sense. **

**We know Democrats want the state, not the parents, to control education. We have seen that ANY money to help underprivileged children is fought against so much so that they've started a petition drive. This is despite receiving $1 billion in new state funds!

The Education Lobbyists will not tolerate a the system of freedom and common sense and they must have total control OF ALL MONEY.**

**The fight wages on! Join us at the Capitol! Support our Senators and elected leaders just as you did during the latest Unicameral session. T****he 2nd House MUST be there to support common sense Republican values and an open discussion of where education needs to be restored.** **The Democrats will be there; Republicans...will you?**

_Todd Watson
Political Director_

|

|
## Give Parents Control over their Children’s Education
---
| **WIN **\- Empower parents in selecting the school their child attends by funding school choice
**[LB753 (Linehan) Adopt the Opportunity Scholarships Act and provide tax credits](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=e29eaf53ad&e=25844e23a8)**
---
|
## **🚨 ****Senator Linehan & Nebraska Students Need Your Help **
---
| The Nebraska Democratic Party and the Nebraska teachers union are in overdrive take away parental rights and repeal LB753, the Opportunity Scholarships Act. They are doing and saying whatever they need to, spreading misinformation and lies, to gather the signatures to get a repeal on the ballot.

We need Republicans across the state to get involved and help the Keep Kids First Decline to Sign campaign defeat their effort! **We especially need people to go where petitioners are to be a Voter Education Advocate. Email[lauren@keepkidsfirstnebraska.com](mailto:lauren@keepkidsfirstnebraska.com) if you’re willing to do this!**

Please [TAKE ACTION](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9b6331fdd9&e=25844e23a8) now and [join the Keep Kids First campaign](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=dd9a7e7e56&e=25844e23a8) to get the Truth out about School Choice! Follow the campaign on [Facebook](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=d7f7c03778&e=25844e23a8) and [Twitter](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=ed0cc5595f&e=25844e23a8).

name: Team D'Esposito
subject: 30 hours to go. Are you in?
body:
Peter,

We are down to the wire.

There's only 30 hours left [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=link&utm_campaign=30+Hours+To+Go+Are+You+In+Email] before our end of July filing deadline.

The urgency cannot be understated - our mission is to protect Nassau County from decisions threatening our values and way of life.

Are you in? Chip in today. [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=link&utm_campaign=30+Hours+To+Go+Are+You+In+Email]

HELP REACH OUR GOAL → [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=first+button&utm_campaign=30+Hours+To+Go+Are+You+In+Email]

State Senator Kevin Thomas can't hide from his record.

1. He has consistently sided with radical-left, "progressive" politicians from New York City, with a shocking voting record of 98.6% in line with them (*LRS voting record, 2019-2022).

2. Despite the evident failure of the notorious Cashless Bail Law, Thomas has stubbornly supported it, prioritizing criminals over law-abiding citizens.

3. He has backed the "Clean Slate" bill and voted to decriminalize loitering for prostitution, again prioritizing the interests of criminals.

4. His support for record tax hikes, reckless spending increases, and a new commuter tax scheme have hurt our economy and made New York less affordable.

5. During the COVID pandemic, he consistently supported the Governor's expanded "emergency powers," neglecting the Legislature's role as a separate, co-equal branch of government.

6. His votes have resulted in wasteful spending, with billions handed out to non-US citizens and funding for political campaigns, even as millions of hardworking New Yorkers struggle to make ends meet.

The litany of Kevin Thomas's wrong decisions is long, and the time for change is now.

With only 1 day left until our filing deadline, your donation can help secure our community's future.

Whether it's $5, $50, or $500, your support will make a significant difference in these final crucial hours. We have 30 hours. Let's show them what we're made of. Dear Sun, **I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.**

**I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.**

But there’s also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn’t what it used to be.

I’ve been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That’s the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That’s 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.
**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. **Joining the Sun costs as little as $0.01 per day.** I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

## U.S. Military Hunting for Chinese Malware
The U.S. military is investigating [Chinese malware](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwzAMBp9G3hRQlOOfQUMXb-na0ZBkKmYhW4bFJsjbF-nc7QM-4HC4r9t885x5v3_6jZykMvso_KAZem2NRjtjs7hEhGQbcqYbYQAcwDSrS-NACD52MYDBa0jWBwhDXAjGiO3SsENAC701Bgy210sMNF7HFK1NbReGQbVAC0s5L9-Fd1kp5Vd50HmJZWuyW0WOquyHwknhtL-OUuV9KZzeYIUT9O89Kpx-qub9QVX47oWqPkqtHDLpuPJOlfTm89OfpL3ojTOLP186-EpV4dScbjmenDPXrlct3DfP-U9C_m_yGwAA___dwWNN) it believes is hidden in networks controlling the infrastructure that powers American military bases around the world. The discovery of the malware last month resulted in a series of White House meetings with top military and intelligence officials worried that the Chinese code could affect water systems, pipelines, radar, and aviation systems. One congressional source described it as a ["ticking time bomb"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu6zAQBb-G6iSQSz0LFrdh59umFFbU0tqAD0NizPjvA6dOd4ADDAbzcVtvyIHT_T9GMsXnFV3hJ61yarVqQa_Q7MYTAemGjBoXOUuYpWoOQ5qIYBikG_d9Qu_nRdPWb5ObNzWM2LABCVpOWimpoB86t9EyLN5p7ftxm2fRS9q55LP7zJzKQT688pPOzuXYBHOU8riE_ifACrC11s6l9P4E2DdZgJXTey8C7CMHLuwuAdYdnLCNGCqe1Bbkiqn9utrIgQueLwGW007f3VFiaE6zPyqHwNc4iV7eI3L4FSh_9_gJAAD__xucYVM) that China could set off in case of a conflict with the U.S.
## Congress, Courts Battle Over Authority

name: Al Franken via Blue Amp Action
subject: Peter, here’s why I support Josh — and why you should too!
body:
We can take this House seat
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T51dd016e-61a3-4658-8089-40c9e6479906/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

[I’m writing because I want you to split $10 or whatever you can (or more than you can) between Blue Amp Action and my friend Josh Riley to help him win one of the most important races in the country in 2024.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T55785aa4-737d-4988-9c2b-ce7db4b358d2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Here’s why I support Josh — and why you should too! Josh knows policy issues backward and forward. Together Josh and I did good stuff when he was my counsel on the U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee – good stuff like protecting victims of domestic violence. In the Violence Against Women Act, Josh and I wrote a provision that protected survivors of domestic violence from homelessness. And Josh and I got that protection through a divided Senate, a Republican House, and signed into law. Republicans lie and say Josh was bad on crime, but here’s the truth. Josh and I advanced legislation that funded the police! Providing bullet-proof vests for local and state police. And funding crisis intervention training to teach police officers how to de-escalate situations. [Will you join me by splitting a contribution between Blue Amp Action and Josh’s campaign today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T322e669b-4a1b-4833-b4ff-6e07f7fa09a0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Will you join me by splitting a contribution between Blue Amp Action and Josh’s campaign today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td0eae3f3-8bea-4f42-b1a0-c2c35d8a9eb5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) This is important to me. ---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Big Ag corporations are lobbying for a bill to let them HIDE their pollution from you — STOP them before it’s too late!** **> > [Sign the petition now!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1905335?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** You know it as well as I do, Friend: the climate crisis is getting worse every day. _**Wildfires. Hurricanes. Floods.**_ Many cities saw some of the worst air quality in their history this summer. We know who is responsible for this crisis. Agribusiness corporations produce massive amounts of methane and toxic pollution from waste generated by **innocent animals crammed into small, filthy spaces.** Industrial animal agriculture is among the **TOP CONTRIBUTORS to the climate crisis** – but Big Ag is working desperately to hide that from the public. The Biden Administration has proposed a new policy to finally require some of the biggest offenders to disclose their greenhouse gas emissions. _**But Republicans are fighting back**_ with a bill in Congress that would **allow companies to withhold this information** and continue to **pollute in private as our planet burns.** [**Tell Congress: hold Big Ag accountable for driving the climate crisis! Sign by 11:59pm TONIGHT!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1905336?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1905337?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Friend,
As a dedicated advocate for universal healthcare and a candidate for the US Congress, I want to share a deeply personal story with you.
I've witnessed the devastating impact of not only illnesses like cancer but also the burden of medical debt that follows in its wake.
In 1994, my older brother, Stephen, fought a valiant battle against cancer. Before his diagnosis, he was a giant personality. As a single father, he raised an amazing daughter. He even once ran a marathon backwards. Stephen was a force to be reckoned with on the rugby field and a talented photographer.
I admired him.
But, cancer didn't care. He died at 42.
I've witnessed firsthand the financial strain cancer patients like him endure. It's heartbreaking every time — watching someone's beloved family member suffer both physically and emotionally, all-the-while grappling with mounting medical bills.
I needed to take action. So, throughout my career, I dedicated my life of service to vulnerable, low income patients like my brother. And, just last year, I drafted — and successfully passed — a resolution with the Michigan Democratic Party to address the pressing issue of medical debt.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
We must alleviate the financial burden on families and individuals, ensuring that they can focus on healing and recovery instead of worrying about bankruptcy.
Over 40% of cancer patients deplete their funds in just two years.
I am committed to fighting for a publicly financed, national, non-profit health insurance program, and wiping out medical debt. We must provide full coverage for medical expenses for all American citizens. Together, we can ensure that no family has to choose between their health and financial stability ever again. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
I want to be the first family physician in Congress to help pass comprehensive healthcare reform. We need a doctor in the House.
When elected, I will lead Congress on this issue.
I cannot achieve this alone. , I need your support [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] . By making a contribution to our campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] , you will help us reach more voters, raise awareness about the urgent need for healthcare reform, and provide hope to countless individuals burdened by medical debt.
Together, we can transform lives and build a healthier, more compassionate nation.
I know my brother would be proud of our efforts. It's for him, his family, and millions of cancer patients like him that our battle endures.
Join our fight.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser

body:
Hi, it’s Anna Kaplan, Democratic candidate for Congress against George
Santos.

The Cook Political Report released a preview of the 2024 Congressional
elections, listing NY-3 as one of the top pickup opportunities for
Democrats.

Here’s why: Our district voted for President Biden in 2020. And George
Santos BARELY won his seat in 2022. And we’ve now learned that he LIED his
way to victory.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/19012?t=1001&akid=3451%2E346206%2EfjZ9cZ ]If Democrats retake this seat in 2024, we’ll take a MASSIVE step toward
flipping the House. Will you pitch in $25 or more -- split with Charles
Booker -- to help me defeat Santos and flip the House?

Senate, and Governorship.

When I defeat George Santos in 2024, we’ll flip the seat from red to blue
and win back control of the House for Democrats, taking the Speaker’s

Thanks for your support,

Anna Kaplan

## **5 Crises DeSantis Has Neglected While Running For President**
**Loomer:** Hey, everybody. Welcome to a new episode of Loomer Unleashed. I'm your host, Laura Loomer. And on today's episode of Loomer Unleashed, we're going to talk about how Ron DeSantis is now an absentee Governor in the state of Florida and how he has abandoned Floridians for the sake of pursuing his failing presidential campaign.
**Loomer:** While Ron DeSantis continues to fall in national presidential polls, the crisis that Floridians are experiencing when it comes to their ability to pay for things like utilities, insurance, and keeping their families safe from the looming immigration crisis here in the state of Florida is only getting worse. You see, over the last few years, the mainstream media and the GOP establishment have both created a facade around Ron DeSantis in the state of Florida.
**Loomer:** You may have heard things like, wow, Ron DeSantis is the best governor in America, or wow, Florida is the free state of Florida. And as a Florida resident, I'm here to tell you that that's just simply not true. The media and the GOP RINO establishment created this false narrative, and they peddled it on a national scale because they needed to convince the American people that Donald Trump wasn't worthy of a second term.
**Loomer:** However, if you actually live in Florida or you take a moment to speak to Floridians or you come to Florida to understand the situation on the ground, you'll quickly find out that life in Florida really isn't so great. So in this episode, we're going to delve into several issues that are affecting the quality of life for Floridians. And I'm going to make the case as to why Ron DeSantis needs to end his failing presidential campaign and come back to Florida and do the job that he was elected to do and that's a second term as governor of Florida.
**Loomer:** The first crisis that Ron DeSantis is not addressing and has completely neglected amid his presidential tour is the growing insurance crisis here in the state of Florida. Currently, as it stands, Florida has the highest property homeowner insurance rates in the entire country. The average Florida homeowner is paying over $6,000 per year for their insurance rates, while the national average is $1,700.
**Loomer:** The rise in premiums is now exceeding the cost of some people's mortgages, making life in Florida extremely unaffordable, especially if you're a senior citizen living on Social Security or a fixed income. This, without a doubt, is going to cause a housing market crash here in the state of Florida. And Ron DeSantis better get on this soon because we are quickly approaching hurricane season and all it's going to take is one really nasty, catastrophic hurricane here in Florida to wipe out hundreds of thousands of homes in the state of Florida and the market is going to crash.
**Loomer:** This year alone, over 17 insurance carriers have pulled out of providing coverage from the state of Florida, with farmers insurance being the latest insurance carrier to pull out this week. This has forced nearly 2 million Floridians to take out policies with citizens homeowner's insurance, which is the state insurer of last resort here in the state of Florida.
**Loomer:** However, Citizens Insurance is insolvent. They don't even have enough reserves right now to currently pay out claims from the last hurricane, Hurricane Ian, that left thousands of Floridians without a home and without roofs. The second crisis that is worsening here in the state of Florida is the malaria crisis. You may have heard that there are several active malaria cases here in the state of Florida.
**Loomer:** And this is a pretty big problem because we haven't had a case of malaria in the United States of America for the last 20 years. But now various communities throughout the state of Florida are being plagued with this infectious disease. And Governor Ron DeSantis has yet to comment on it, and he's nowhere to be found. Why? Because he's too busy jet setting around the country in states like Iowa, New Hampshire, and Nevada pretending like he's going to be the next president.
**Loomer:** Along with the malaria crisis, Ron DeSantis has also been completely silent over the fact that he allowed for hundreds of thousands of genetically engineered mosquitoes to be released into the state of Florida. Florida residents had expressed outrage over a British company announcing their plans to release hundreds of thousands of genetically engineered mosquitoes in the state of Florida. But it was still approved by the state under Ron DeSantis' administration.

**Loomer:** And now, with the growing cases of malaria, a lot of people are asking "Why?" and "Where is Ron DeSantis on this?" Oh, yeah, that's right. He's nowhere to be found because he's an absentee governor. The third crisis that is plaguing the pockets of millions of Florida citizens is the growing utility crisis. You may have noticed, if you live here in the state of Florida, like I do, that you're paying a lot of money for your utilities, money that you may not be able to afford to spend.
**Loomer:** In fact, over the last year alone, there has been a 22% increase in utility bills, which is the largest increase in Florida history. And why are utility prices so high? Well, you may have noticed, if you take a look at the expenditure reports, that Ron DeSantis and his allies in the Florida Republican Party have received a total of over nine and a half million dollars from groups like FPL and their subsidiaries.
**Loomer:** Recent reports show that the average monthly electric bill here in the state of Florida is 13% higher than the national average. You can guarantee that that's causing a major financial crisis for many Floridians, because Florida also happens to have the nation's highest rate of inflation. In fact, Ron DeSantis allowed for the Florida Public Service Commission Board to be stacked with his appointees, and shortly after stacking it with his hand-selected appointees the commission approved the largest electric hike in Florida history in 2021, resulting in a 20% increase in electric costs to Florida residents.
**Loomer:** And of course, Ron DeSantis doesn't seem to give a damn about this. And why would he as long as he continues to receive enormous amounts of campaign contributions from all of the companies that he's assisting? The next crisis that is creating not only a crime crisis in the state of Florida, but a public safety issue for Floridians is the growing immigration crisis.
**Loomer:** Under Ron DeSantis, illegal alien migrant boat crossings into Florida have increased substantially. In fact, according to reports by the U.S. Border Patrol and Coast Guard, Florida has experienced the largest escalation in illegal alien migrations via boat into Florida in the last decade all under the DeSantis administration. And look, Ron DeSantis can make all the fancy campaign commercials for his presidential campaign that he wants while he's posing in his aviator sunglasses at the U.S. southern border, pretending like he's going to crack down on illegal immigration.
**Loomer:** If Ron DeSantis is so focused on securing our borders, maybe he ought to get his ass back down to Florida where he's supposed to be working and doing his job as governor and secure our borders here. Because as it stands, Florida is being invaded by hundreds of illegal aliens from places like Cuba and Haiti on a weekly basis.
**Loomer:** And lastly, when Ron DeSantis finally realizes that he has no chance of making it to the White House, perhaps he can address another issue of grave concern to Floridians. And that's the fact that he has allowed for the Capitol Police to set up their own office in Tampa, Florida, for the sake of tracking down patriots who attended the January six protests over our stolen election.

**Loomer:** Now, if Ron DeSantis is such a patriot and so America first, why is he allowing for Capitol Police to work in collusion with the FBI and local law enforcement officers to literally hunt down Trump supporters in the state of Florida? And if you've been following my reports, you know that Florida has the highest number of J6 defendants.
**Loomer:** And to this day, over two years after the protests on January 6th of 2021, Floridians are still having their doors kicked in by the FBI, and many Floridians are jailed in gulags where they have even been denied treatment for their cancer simply because they are Trump supporters and political prisoners who were brave enough to show up and protest January 6th.
**Loomer:** And what has Ron DeSantis done about this? Absolutely nothing. In fact, testimony from several of the family members of Floridians who are literally rotting away in jail cells right now over their participation on January six have said publicly that Ron DeSantis doesn't answer their phone calls. But hey, don't take it from me. Take it from their mouth directly.
**Loomer:** I think that we can all agree at this point that Ron DeSantis' presidential campaign is an absolute disaster. It's time for Ron DeSantis to come to terms with the fact that he's losing to Donald Trump. It's time for Ron DeSantis to come to terms with the fact that he's never going to be president of the United States of America.
**Loomer:** And unless Ron DeSantis wants to continue down this path of absolute political annihilation and political suicide, I suggest he end his presidential campaign and come back to Florida and stop being an absentee governor. The people of Florida deserve better. They didn't vote for a part time governor. They didn't vote for an absentee governor. They voted for somebody who they thought was going to be dedicated to Floridians and dedicated to the job of a four year second term, which is what he promised us.
**Loomer:** Time will only tell if Ron DeSantis is going to come to his senses about his failing presidential campaign and what decision he's going to make. Is he going to continue running for president and allow for all of these crises in the state of Florida to get even more out of control? Or will he come back to Florida and do the job that the taxpayers are paying him to do?
**Loomer:** I really hope that Ron DeSantis makes the right decision soon, not for his sake, but for the sake of Floridians.

_This is a longer, personal note from Marcy. We hope you’ll take a moment to read it from beginning to end and hear why this community and this fight mean so much to Marcy. If you don’t have time (that’s okay!), **[please consider clicking here to make a contribution and help keep Marcy fighting for Northern Ohio families.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67344739/419384190/197685099?refcode=EM_FR_230731MyHouse_N_MK_90DO_9_NG_N_L1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2FhNGY1ZC1hNjJmLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=K7xMUlCud8sPvjpG5qtWyW48f7fQd3Qo3psJAVe0JUA=)**_ I want to talk to you about my house. No, not the House of Representatives, but my childhood home in Toledo, where I still reside today.

Where I come from, a house still means a lot. It represents family and the stake we hold in our community. My grandparents were Polish immigrants choosing to lay down roots and raise their families in Toledo. They instilled diligence and duty into my parents - mom worked in a spark plug factory where she served on the UAW organizing committee, and dad retired from Jeep and ran a small family grocery store.

As the house was passed down, so too were the values of hard work and community service. Because my parents invested in me, I was the first person in my family to go to college. I worked in urban planning and development, but when my community asked me to step up and run for Congress, I answered the call.

I have lived in this district, in the same house, for most of my life. My constituents are friends and neighbors, and I am honored to serve and fight for them.

Governing is not always glamorous. Crafting, amending, and passing legislation is a grueling process that requires the dedication and patience my parents instilled in me. It involves identifying the needs of a community and then fighting hard to bring back the resources needed to help the region thrive.

From funding for job training in our schools or constructing the World War II Memorial to securing funding for a vegetable garden at a senior housing complex and holding back the Asian carp’s invasion of the Great Lakes, no project can be too daunting.

I love this district like I love my house. Our work is both challenging and fulfilling. It is the highest honor of my life to serve our community. I will always put forth my very best effort for the people of Northern Ohio because they deserve nothing less.

| | Good Morning Republicans,

I’ll be completely honest with you...I never liked coffee until Covid. I am normally not one to enjoy volcanic hot drinks like ciders or coffee that sear off my taste buds. Funny enough, I had been preparing the coffee pot for over a decade of making coffee for my wife, but never consumed it myself. I would fill the water the night before, make a choice of which flavor of coffee I believed my wife would like in the morning, set a timer for 15-20 mins before her alarm would go off, and go to bed at peace with the little act of service for my spouse. In 2020, as the world slowed down and life pivoted to more time at home, I found myself changing routines and habits.

I decided to start getting up before my wife and pouring her a cup of coffee and mine as well. It's that little bit of time spent with her before the kids get out of bed. Sometimes we’d chat about the previous day, sometimes about the day coming up. We’d both spend time in The Word and we might discuss something of interest that God had laid out for us. I go to bed at night now, looking forward to my coffee and time with my wife.

Everywhere in Nebraska something similar to my story is happening in the morning. A cup of coffee, brewed and dispensed in a familiar cup or thermos. Those cups and thermos have have a connection to the person who gave it or the place you got it from. Usually, the message on the cup says something of importance to your life. You probably have a specific spot where you drink your coffee...that certain chair, couch, desk, or outdoor option. In many small towns across Nebraska, there is a local spot like VFW’s or the fire department or the general store or local gas station where the “early risers” go and share the gossip of the week (sometimes repeated EVERY day). If you buy your coffee cup from a chain business, I guarantee you have an opinion on who has “the best” coffee. And sometimes, you might spoil yourself and go to one of the specialty coffee businesses and get lattes or cappuccinos, flavored like a candy bar or iced because it's trendy & chic!

Eventually, we Nebraskans get on with the work of our day. We finish putting on the blue collar, white collar, plaid collar, scrub collar...whatever uniform or clothing appropriate for the day. As we go throughout our day we want to get out of the day, what we put into it. Yet, throughout the day we receive little...distractions...of what's “happening” in the world or our communities. We become engaged in the content of "news". This content might come from your local media, or social media, or even text/chat conversations, but regardless we are now distracted with something that usually has a level of importance that creates a Call to Action. A moment or thought, where you say, “I’ve gotta do something about this. I’ve gotta say something about this. I’ve gotta make others aware or I’ve gotta find a solution!”

_**“I’ve gotta DO something!”**_

This is where the message of my first newsletter comes to you today. You are right...with what is happening in our World, with what is happening in our communities...**you’ve** gotta do something.

You have to say; “enough is enough”.

What happens next in the Call to Action is up to you. This is what I did in 2020...I believed that my voice and skill sets could make an impact and have influence to promote or effect change not only within the Republican party, but within my community. I said, “enough is enough”. I then surrounded myself with strong, passionate individuals who are becoming the leaders of the NEGOP.

Join me.
Join the hundreds of NEGOP leaders, who have said “enough is enough”. Join your local county party or local active political groups. ENGAGE others in dialogue and discussion that increases your knowledge and awareness of the Republican party’s governing apparatus.

_Don't_ post on Facebook.
_Don’t_ Twitter tweet. (or whatever Elon is calling it now)
_Don’t_ send “You should...” emails to elected officials.
_Don’t_ sit and fume about the way things “should be done”.

**Go** to County Party meetings
**Go** to School Board meetings
**Go** to City Council meetings
**Speak** with confidence and knowledge, passion and articulation at county party, school board, and city council meetings.
**Speak** with others at your church or community organizations.
**Become** a county delegate in 2024 ****The NEGOP can show you how** **
**Become** an elected member of your County Party ****The NEGOP can show you how****
**Become** an elected member of the State Party ****The NEGOP can show you how**
Become** a candidate for your local school board and _really_ have an impact on your community ****The NEGOP can show you how****
**Become** a candidate for your city council, village board, NRD, ESU, county boards, community college boards, or energy boards. ****The NEGOP can show you how****

There are over _**900 elected Democrats**_ in the State of Nebraska and they are almost **ALL** at your local political entities. They ARE on your local school boards allowing pornography in the libraries and they ARE telling YOU it's YOUR fault if kids aren’t parented correctly to know right from wrong. They are telling you it’s YOUR fault Nebraska's students have below 50% proficiency scores in Reading, Writing, Math, & Science. They are telling you it’s YOUR fault that kids don’t care about America, or Patriotism or Civic Duties.

## Spotlight Feature: From Rep Loren Lippincott
---
| Recently I watched the movie “The Sound of Freedom,” which, appropriately enough, was released on Independence Day. The movie bested the Indiana Jones movie that week, which says Americans long for movies that are true life stories of good triumphing over evil. The movie portrayed an American government official who tracked down a kidnapped young son and daughter. The children’s father was tricked by a woman who told him the kids were attending a day-long audition for parts in a movie. When the father came to pick them up at the end of the day, he found only an empty building.

The American agent, played by Jim Caviezel, went to great lengths to recover the children. The movie will leave you sober, saddened, and distraught at the depths of the depravity of mankind.

The true story the film is based on took place beyond our southern border. We tell ourselves those things do not happen here, but they do! We have even had several incidents of human trafficking in the 34th Legislative District recently! Twenty-seven percent of those trafficked are children. They are mostly used for labor, but some are sold as sex slaves. Of the children trafficked, 66 percent are girls.

Overall, Nebraska has seen 92 prosecutions for human trafficking for labor and sex slavery, with 88 of those prosecutions in just the past seven years. Furthermore, this is happening more often, aided and abetted by the current administration’s loose open-border policies. Since President Biden took office, the number of illegals crossing our southern border has increased fivefold. According to Customs and Border Patrol agents, nearly 2.5 million illegals cross our border yearly.

According to a Massachusetts Institute of Technology Operational Data Simulation (performed one million times), there are now 16-29 million illegals in the United States. In Biden’s first five months alone, five million illegals crossed our southern border, and soon one-tenth of our entire population will consist of illegals.

Reports show many of these individuals are single, military-age men, inmates from foreign prisons, gang members, known terrorists, and unaccompanied minors. Many women are raped during their journey to illegal entry into our country.

During my time at Delta Airlines, based in Atlanta, Georgia -- home of the world’s busiest airport -- the company would brief us on what to look for in passengers who were possibly trafficking minors or young adults on our aircraft. The flight attendants would be vigilant in looking for anything suspicious while serving the customers. Though I never encountered this on one of my flights, I knew of traffickers apprehended from other Delta flights.

Trafficking is a despicable and reprehensible crime! Forcibly abusing another person against their will for your pleasure or profit is heinous.

What can you, as an individual American do? Keep your eyes and ears open for suspicious behavior that might suggest enslavement. Worldwide, slavery is more widespread now than at any time in history. Our borders are extremely porous, and we are a marketplace with money. Our State Attorney General Mike Hilgers has set up a Human Trafficking Hotline at 888-373-7888. Don’t hesitate to call it if you see something suspicious. Consider joining the ministry of helping trafficked people get back on their feet after being set free. You can volunteer with the State Department of Health and Human Services at 402-471-3121.

But to start with, get informed. Make it a point to see The Sound of Freedom while it is playing in local theaters. It is well worth watching. In the closing credits of the movie, Caviezel tells of the struggle Angel Studios had in bringing the movie to theaters. It took five years of fighting marketplace forces that did not want the truth of this movie to be shown to Americans. This film clearly shows the anguish of children being separated from their families and the evils of those who enslave them. But it also shows how one brave and courageous man, empowered and guided by the hand of God, can prevail against the odds.

body:
The RUMOR Is TRUE... The last three years have been more than interesting... In the midst of all the craziness, we have seen tremendous growth at Sh

## The RUMOR Is TRUE...
---
The last three years have been more than interesting... In the midst of all the craziness, we have seen **tremendous growth** at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.203.1.1d2ec6cfc231a9b76506eb58c8737486). We have currently maxed out our facility in Tulsa with two services every Sunday. Last year, we were blessed to acquire 14 acres in South Tulsa but that did not solve our immediate need. I am excited to share with you that [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.204.1.77c37ac722530566b2a28af2af8b09c3) is purchasing the historic **Caravan Nightclub** in Tulsa, OK. Features of the new facility: **-Auditorium will seat 700+**
**-Separate Kids & Youth Wing**
**-Over 400 parking spaces** We are needing to raise around $250,000 to complete the buildout of turning this once nightclub into a church. I would like for you to pray and consider partnering with us to see this **incredible story of a former tavern becoming a temple in Tulsa**. You can watch this short video to see what the Caravan Nightclub looks like right now:[https://youtu.be/aq9FDBtTcvA](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.205.1.5f40fc041b7af126874b50ec09f71efb) You can partner with [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.206.1.6119aa13e513a5dbe1cd3af7fdfcf17e) by visiting: [www.sheridan.church/give](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.207.1.4501401b6411c0cf349196fb89e45089) I am very grateful for your support! Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer Follow me on [TruthSocial](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.208.1.a79a6209498dff9ce03e17922f142f30), GAB, [Facebook](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.209.1.026cdaea0e417d89279f75b3f65c7cf2), [Instagram](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.210.1.9cb691d25aaf3ffd9c7233dd56c03a6b), [Twitter](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.211.1.34da9f7e1b4ad4b483367979f8d92887), [Telegram](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.212.1.2ef90df9b2f7746e5bfc1c263ae96960), GETTR & [YouTube](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.213.1.75071551ca34e370c6dcd9ab10d1f292)). [www.jacksonlahmeyer.com](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.214.1.41342d99f705eb053314d35cf086db35)

## Two BROKE Preachers Going To Church...
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.216.1.2a45695c595aba055d88f4009fb7c660)
---
At [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.217.1.f0e37c50ccf91440cc9613222d17c8b7) OKC & Tulsa, we are in a series each WKND over the [Book of Acts](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.218.1.87e96895e32801413d9fb2dfb985f338): _verse by verse_.
This past WKND, we opened up **Acts 3** which is a story of two broke preachers (Peter & John) going to church and on their way encountering a man who lame from birth asking for money.
I took a different approach to this classic biblical story and I think you will be intrigued by the angel of this sermon.
Watch [Acts Pt.12](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.219.1.690f7ba1efc151e1addc97b95dd0c2f1) here: [https://youtube.com/live/ThM7my6KqHU?feature=share ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.220.1.1dea6d88a5361d0b94c6358dab1b83b5)
| | [ Acts Pt. 12 - Two Broke Preachers Going To Church ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.221.1.48fdb9e5abc7fb2ceb640b3bf27091c3)
---
---
## Why Are American Churches Struggling?
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.222.1.14b9cb393b0a20a86baee76e6b0b5b64)
---
**American Churches** were once _booming_ like many _boom towns_ in our nation's history.
Unfortunately, the trend now for many American Churches is not the boom town experience but more like a _ghost town_...
Did you know that twelve churches per day in America **close down**? Church attendance is at an **all time low**. In 1972 around 92%of Americans identified as Christian, whereas in 2020 that number dropped to 64%.
**Why is American Christianity struggling?**
Two Sundays ago, at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.223.1.6c554cf4125e6bb338aa3efd366aea42) OKC & Tulsa, I addressed that question and how a church can **BOOM**.
We have seen the **BOOM** experience at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.224.1.cb1d59d3de2fdb4ad3fdc29cfdccf16b) in all categories: reach, influence, attendance & finances.
There are **four primary reasons** that [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.225.1.a04da1267c2d3ea1ad31a7930e35ddbe) has boomed and they are found in **Acts 2:42**.
This message will bless you and your local church!
Watch here: [https://www.youtube.com/live/YCcVTz88FMo?feature=share](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.226.1.c7cba707001c7d424f24abc446f640f1)
| | [ Partner w/Sheridan.Church ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.227.1.f2a324723a5fe95c9a8f4ff8a56ee781)
---

## When It's OK To Disobey
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.228.1.6ce70d5e5c2df6ecc715f0ea36558e1c)
---
Is there a time when it is OK to disobey civil authoirty as a Christian?
The answer is YES.
Watch Daniel Pt. 4 - When It's OK To Disobey: [https://www.youtube.com/live/4at5EzLq68c?feature=share](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=429707.229.1.eb4179a1e57554758a065dce8a58b892)

subject: I know this is a little longer than usual
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia
body:
Hi Friend,
It's Hung Cao, and I want to level with you.
Sending emails like this isn't something I enjoy. And you know what? I'm willing to bet you're just as tired of receiving them from every single politician in Washington. Trust me, my inbox is overflowing, and I'm as fed up with them as you are.
So here's the deal: I won't beg you for money or resort to flashy tactics. Instead, I'm going to lay it all out on the table and be completely upfront with you.
When it all comes down to it, people from every corner of our nation will scrutinize the amount of money we've raised during this crucial first month since I announced my campaign. We have an opportunity to make a resounding impact, and we need to seize the moment.
As I mentioned before, I don't like sending these emails and texts, but can you guess what I do love doing?
I LOVE having the chance to prove all the doubters wrong--the ones who laugh at me for having hope in America, who question our ability to triumph over an incumbent Democrat, and those who doubt I can turn this blue state into a red one.
To them, I say: Bring it on.
I've always told you that I don't shy away from a fight, and I mean it.
If you're someone who shares that spirit and refuses to back down, join me in the trenches of this new mission, and let's show the world what we're truly capable of.
I won't pretend it'll be easy, but by joining forces, we'll send a resounding message that true change starts from the ground up. We'll prove that ordinary people united by a common purpose can defy the odds and create a future where our voices are heard.
So, team, if you're as determined as I am, let's rise above the noise. Let's show them what we're made of.
[**https://secure.winred.com/hung-cao-for-virginia/first-deadline-almost-here**](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=703dc7b21aec435ea2d675a894ac4707&_e=895vFlc-o49NUWihzebQPMo3caP1aH1p0QPXH4tjZXJra2WBFMisPjm7ij-od1N1vFLcbMG9T1nsxx6YTJPyDNNYyDVhuOUB5o-k_41d6ytM1wT1xfLeqBh0CNe5ECXsigcE09TJO7337H9oOcfsGPzoRb-tR6YQdKrLiyG2QI3coFL3XPEGHWNiZOxbL6hGd6gMwMolQaQlK5bo7w279XWzMEKeDW3aVHwTsj4LM1jbBhvTijDbdB7iOp7l1_e7dvxmeeMetVyuWGPzr-ylyVep2X0LuCyX9w9IP7k474uk49Q-MGPAvEYvZY2z06s1_iaNY9tatNMTOcvIwHIWKp_Jqq10Iw-ron4es2ZZV6w1aUovvvyA4sNQ5odTqpjjSgt_e_GnMS5ubhc3qKAfLw%3D%3D)
Thank you for standing shoulder-to-shoulder with me in the battle to save this great Nation. Together, we'll prove that passion, grit, and grassroots support can turn the tide in our state and our country.
-Hung

subject: I am humbly asking you to contribute $3 to the Long Run ahead of our July fundraising deadline
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC
body:
#
Friends -
[**I am humbly asking you to contribute $3 to the Long Run ahead of our July fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jul23.p2zS7g&refcode=em230731-1-tt&t=1&akid=4701%2E196590%2EJFp7mg)
I began this movement to fight for something bigger than me, and I was humbled by the outpouring of support I received.
This movement was made to support and elect groundbreaking candidates up and down the ballot — candidates who will bring working people’s voices to the table across the country.
In less than 6 months, we have grown and lived up to our mission — the work we are doing is truly making a difference.
With the help of this team, Wisconsin elected Judge Janet Protasiewicz to the state Supreme Court and flipped the court’s ideological majority for the first time in 15 years. With this team's support, Lashrecse Aird defeated an anti-abortion incumbent in the Virginia state Senate primary and can continue her fight to protect reproductive rights in Virginia. And this is just the beginning of what's possible when we work together.
Throughout the highs and lows, one thing has been constant: I can’t do this work without your continued support. And I mean that in every way.
I know that as long as I have you by my side, we will continue to support candidates that will protect reproductive freedom, defend democracy and fight for a better future. We will continue to fuel changemaking candidates that will mobilize voters instead of disenfranchising them. And we will continue to bolster candidates that will be the difference between protecting the planet and letting corporate special interests destroy it.
[**So if you are with me, please make a contribution to our movement before our critical July fundraising deadline at midnight tonight. Every single dollar will help us support candidates that will protect our democracy.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jul23.p2zS7g&refcode=em230731-1-tt&t=2&akid=4701%2E196590%2EJFp7mg)

body:

| | |

## The RUMOR Is TRUE...
---
The last three years have been more than interesting... In the midst of all the craziness, we have seen **tremendous growth** at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.235.1.5a7baf216923fc5efb55ba8515b5eb79). We have currently maxed out our facility in Tulsa with two services every Sunday. Last year, we were blessed to acquire 14 acres in South Tulsa but that did not solve our immediate need. I am excited to share with you that [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.236.1.45ffaebf880f3dbbcdcc0df628eba621) is purchasing the historic **Caravan Nightclub** in Tulsa, OK. Features of the new facility: **-Auditorium will seat 700+**
**-Separate Kids & Youth Wing**
**-Over 400 parking spaces** We are needing to raise around $250,000 to complete the buildout of turning this once nightclub into a church. I would like for you to pray and consider partnering with us to see this **incredible story of a former tavern becoming a temple in Tulsa**. You can watch this short video to see what the Caravan Nightclub looks like right now:[https://youtu.be/aq9FDBtTcvA](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.237.1.315724ad373529267621fab626a507f8) You can partner with [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.238.1.b672f4516b544649c457d146e0b965ba) by visiting: [www.sheridan.church/give](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.239.1.ac40f4ebacd80d9a1756200123cbaa1e) I am very grateful for your support! Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer Follow me on [TruthSocial](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.240.1.fdbcf8387244a5ecb68b511ba0657a67), GAB, [Facebook](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.241.1.b409a64066bab10d661a8db64ce81017), [Instagram](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.242.1.c0af6b1ac35e91cc98fe5611ec40b8d1), [Twitter](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.243.1.bd27476b9dc7971a30135d55f974055a), [Telegram](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.244.1.0d0ea177a209899532b15d051491ac54), GETTR & [YouTube](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.245.1.b72b740107f2117a8b903a03b495f9f7)). [www.jacksonlahmeyer.com](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.246.1.5af16dcf3323106871a027c491c34eb0)

## Two BROKE Preachers Going To Church...
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.248.1.c5f4cec21da4914e4b2d1fa65faefa12)
---
At [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.249.1.61ec0812526df66f85b9f3ff0ca2ea16) OKC & Tulsa, we are in a series each WKND over the [Book of Acts](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.250.1.1778a63f36d16f06b2a83620452b0d0b): _verse by verse_.
This past WKND, we opened up **Acts 3** which is a story of two broke preachers (Peter & John) going to church and on their way encountering a man who lame from birth asking for money.
I took a different approach to this classic biblical story and I think you will be intrigued by the angel of this sermon.
Watch [Acts Pt.12](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.251.1.9ab129889fb8c22a0ec282e129b021b8) here: [https://youtube.com/live/ThM7my6KqHU?feature=share ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.252.1.9720e986c61e5a8956250d4db9fa4614)
| | [ Acts Pt. 12 - Two Broke Preachers Going To Church ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.253.1.9c16ee8f62c07c48e94aadd55a52b537)
---
---
## Why Are American Churches Struggling?
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.254.1.f7ec844246441139b97988440e89004c)
---
**American Churches** were once _booming_ like many _boom towns_ in our nation's history.
Unfortunately, the trend now for many American Churches is not the boom town experience but more like a _ghost town_...
Did you know that twelve churches per day in America **close down**? Church attendance is at an **all time low**. In 1972 around 92%of Americans identified as Christian, whereas in 2020 that number dropped to 64%.
**Why is American Christianity struggling?**
Two Sundays ago, at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.255.1.fcda90dd1a5c1ba6c2ce9145eb3c680d) OKC & Tulsa, I addressed that question and how a church can **BOOM**.
We have seen the **BOOM** experience at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.256.1.43c64399c0fc4cfa1ab6399a9a0207e9) in all categories: reach, influence, attendance & finances.
There are **four primary reasons** that [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.257.1.d62a9ceaa7f53c06a3ca4c9e0ab1fcb3) has boomed and they are found in **Acts 2:42**.
This message will bless you and your local church!
Watch here: [https://www.youtube.com/live/YCcVTz88FMo?feature=share](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.258.1.0f6c70963f5f107bb5e7a857af38ca37)
| | [ Partner w/Sheridan.Church ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.259.1.b10295cef2d55dc8b45d68df1a07dcef)
---
---
## When It's OK To Disobey
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.260.1.3e6fc00c543b9df9b9867de8ccd7e64b)
---
Is there a time when it is OK to disobey civil authoirty as a Christian?
The answer is YES.
Watch Daniel Pt. 4 - When It's OK To Disobey: [https://www.youtube.com/live/4at5EzLq68c?feature=share](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=530781.261.1.bdea5a7cef69bec09507c81e78af97e7)

body:
| Hi there —

I know you’re busy, but it’s essential I hear from you right at the start of this week. Tonight, we’re facing our first fundraising deadline since the NRCC zeroed in on KS-03 and defeating Sharice as their means to hold the House.

body:
Please read this message to the end, but only if you’re prepared to handle the reality of our situation.

| |
---
| | | It's Marco. Please read this message to the end, but only if you're prepared to handle the reality of our situation. With only about 30% of folks opening these messages, I believe that by opening this, you're someone who can handle it. I know it's hard to tell fact from fiction these days, but I'm going to level with you and tell you the truth.

On top of only about 30% of our friends opening these messages, only about 1% will go the extra mile by donating. Conservatives like me rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to raise money for our cause, so I'm humbly asking you to read this all the way through. If you still think your $1 doesn't matter, then I want to simply thank you for hearing me out.

**Here's the truth...**

The Democrats stopped our Red Wave in 2022, and we need every little bit if we want to fund the programs needed to win in 2024 - and we need it today.

I don't have deep-pocketed billionaires I can call on to hit these goals. I rely on a couple of bucks here and there from hard-working Americans receiving these messages when they can afford it.

**If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit, we would be able to reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' millions raised. I know it's not much, but all I need from you today is the price of a cup of coffee, a candy bar, or a donut.**
---
| | [I'LL CHIP IN, MARCO!](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1g4jajtkvuj92re0cs0jrerfvq3spllgruihrpg_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3h66ob2cth2bs "I’LL CHIP IN, MARCO!")
---
_**[The Democrats rely on megadonors who give thousands at a time, but I rely on folks like you who can give $10, $13, or even $26.25 to fuel our fight to restore the American Dream.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3gkgqtfpnuo8n0n613lhenp2a80gr5qcgcp047o_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3h66ob2cth2bs "The Democrats rely on megadonors who give thousands at a time, but I rely on folks like you who can give $10, $13, or even $26.25 to fuel our fight to restore the American Dream.")**_
_Democrats are hoping I give up on you.

They're hoping you give up on me.

They're hoping both of us give up on conservative values altogether._
We can't let them run this country into the ground. I'm rolling up my sleeves and continuing to fight for hard-working families like yours - making our country better, stronger, and safer.

_I hope you don't give up on me or our shared values._ A lot of folks are going to ignore this, but I need patriots like you to see what's at stake if you ignore this.

**If you think you're better off than you were 5 years ago, then I understand why you don't want to donate today.**
**But if you think we need to get this country back on track and the American Dream restored, please donate whatever you can afford by midnight!**

| | | Instead of fighting hate speech, [Twitter is fighting the people fighting hate speech](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9752f05b-734a-4091-99c4-642d72de36b3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9): _" Elon Musk has over the last year threatened legal action against tech competitors, employees and people who use Twitter, which he owns. Now he is also taking aim at an organization that studies hate speech and misinformation on social media....X Corp., the parent company of the social media company, sent a letter on July 20 to the Center for Countering Digital Hate, a nonprofit that conducts research on social media...threatening to sue._ _Imran Ahmed, the chief executive of Center for Countering Digital Hate, said, "Elon Musk's actions represent a brazen attempt to silence honest criticism and independent research." (Source: [NYT](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf7cd8473-5bfe-4c96-92ed-b4db02916fbe/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ It's been obvious to anyone watching that hate speech is everywhere on Twitter, and that the company is doing little about it. Instead of taking action to stop it, it is using legal threats against the people shining a spotlight on it. For the past year, I have served as the Chairman of the Mississippi Freedom Caucus, and in that position, I have talked to a lot of potential candidates. Our process generally begins with the candidate completing a lengthy questionnaire. Once their answers are submitted, their responses are reviewed by members of the caucus and members of our steering committee.
If the candidates answers are generally good, and by good, I mean they fit within the caucus philosophy of government, then we move further in the process.
Somewhere along the way, there is a telephone conversation with myself or a member of our steering committee where we review their answers on the questionnaire and dive a little deeper into their ideas and philosophy of government.
There is one question that I believe is the most important for any candidate to answer. That question is, Where do you get your self-worth?
Now most of us know the "proper" answer because in Mississippi, most of us, especially those of us who are conservative, have spent our lives in church. So the immediate answer is usually "my relationship with God, or Jesus". I'm not telling you that's the wrong answer; actually, according to my preacher, it is the only answer, and I believe he is correct. But putting aside the fact that we all know the answer we are supposed to give, Where do you get your self-worth?
It is very important that every politician answer this question honestly and privately. Because where and how you obtain your self-worth is crucial to how you will make decisions once elected.
What does it mean to say you get your self-worth from God? How does that change you and the decisions you make?
If you get your self-worth from God, does it matter to you if the Speaker of the House is upset with you? Does it affect your decisions if you are taken off the governor's party invitation list?
If you are a "people pleaser" how to you correlate that with your answer that you get your self-worth from God?
These are important questions that every politician must answer, or they will be lost in the maze of lobbyists, constituents, bureaucrats, and leadership.

Our process generally begins with the candidate completing a lengthy questionaire. Once their answers are submitted there responses are reviewed by members of the caucus and members of our steering committee. | | ---|---|--- | | | or ? ? from the desk ofDana Criswell | | | Jul 31 | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Photo by on For the past year, I have served as the Chairman of the Mississippi Freedom Caucus, and in that position, I have talked to a lot of potential candidates. Our process generally begins with the candidate completing a lengthy questionnaire. Once their answers are submitted, their responses are reviewed by members of the caucus and members of our steering committee. If the candidates answers are generally good, and by good, I mean they fit within the caucus philosophy of government, then we move further in the process. Somewhere along the way, there is a telephone conversation with myself or a member of our steering committee where we review their answers on the questionnaire and dive a little deeper into their ideas and philosophy of government. There is one question that I believe is the most important for any candidate to answer. That question is, Where do you get your self-worth? Now most of us know the "proper" answer because in Mississippi, most of us, especially those of us who are conservative, have spent our lives in church. So the immediate answer is usually "my relationship with God, or Jesus". I'm not telling you that's the wrong answer; actually, according to my preacher, it is the only answer, and I believe he is correct. But putting aside the fact that we all know the answer we are supposed to give, Where do you get your self-worth? It is very important that every politician answer this question honestly and privately. Because where and how you obtain your self-worth is crucial to how you will make decisions once elected. What does it mean to say you get your self-worth from God? How does that change you and the decisions you make? If you get your self-worth from God, does it matter to you if the Speaker of the House is upset with you? Does it affect your decisions if you are taken off the governor's party invitation list? If you are a "people pleaser" how to you correlate that with your answer that you get your self-worth from God? These are important questions that every politician must answer, or they will be lost in the maze of lobbyists, constituents, bureaucrats, and leadership. body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions

| This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z42i1mkc2avqd8ihedg8jntsos03mdot0q57l8io_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3h6epj6chh2bs)

| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zv4c0s0kgct410mha0n82r6i49uabfam3k38r130_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3h6epj6chh2bs)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgbnlgk42tstgn4nnddaoms6fbc9q0ueg831od10_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3h6epj6chh2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3rjgma338v7smdbc56hing4pl20fnag23efn7jg_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3h6epj6chh2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

body:
| | | Renee wrote to you earlier about why _Their Future_ is important to her despite not having kids.

Now I’m going to tell you about the kids in my life, my three children. But first, I have to ask you to chip in $10 before Their Future PAC’s midnight fundraising deadline. **_[Click here to help.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953ywjAHk5iaSyuXGJuhV0BPwa_xKTDsopFvjs3kbm8iG6H0ACfrzvu0uX6G2_-jA06bYOEWPvksSH58giyPnjDk4liiUv7F-rMHB_EKxfPdGc6iXcY1TpDUnqaixPErKzE27BQb1dEnPa3ItesfaHVoU8JNnw8oEEB_adGlHLqm1-UdVYGP_PPY--6IwfT0e1mFaWLK5dWm_u87fUc4kDhqh8OaRhHA-UvY83_xFdB7Dpjfwi-qRrgoTDOx4PUfT8g9ywp5nYjfC7K1Bt_Qy9YDdZ51vXGQwf9ITUq9psdDNo9YdVUzkBo29H0JIEY09u2Y/3yc/Bxc74g8BQc6j9vMw1wy7SA/h0/Oeo6kemxrci6YxSO28fDLCG-tFMA9xv3MhxmY9bu26g)_**

Society tends to believe that kids can’t connect the dots between what happens in the news with their own lives. But they absolutely do.

I’ve talked to my kids about a lot of the issues making headlines—from the surge in gun violence, to the record-breaking heat waves because of climate change, to voter suppression in states all across the country and its impact on democracy—and they get it.

More than that, they want to know what’s being done about it. The worst effects of these issues and countless others will be felt by their generation and the ones to follow. Up until recently, I had to admit that very little action was taking place.

Unlike the gun lobby or big oil, kids don’t have political money behind them, to defend them in the halls of power. That’s why Their Future PAC is so important, because our organization exists to change that.

Already, we’ve taken several trips to Washington to visit with members of Congress and speak truth to power. We’ve also helped build awareness campaigns, pushed back against state legislatures that don’t have our kids’ best interests at heart, and done so much more in the last few months.

But the fact remains that none of this work comes cheap. Their Future PAC is working around the clock to advocate for our kids and elect better leaders who will take action on their behalf. And we need your help to keep our momentum up. We can not fail at this. Our kids are counting on us.

**_[Will you please chip in $10 or whatever you can before our deadline at midnight tonight? body:
Spotlight Feature: Rep. Loren Lippincott | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ne.gop/n41kepo7ku-12616465?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=358705f2ab&e=25844e23a8)
---
| | Good Morning Republicans,

I’ll be completely honest with you...I never liked coffee until Covid. I am normally not one to enjoy volcanic hot drinks like ciders or coffee that sear off my taste buds. Funny enough, I had been preparing the coffee pot for over a decade of making coffee for my wife, but never consumed it myself. I would fill the water the night before, make a choice of which flavor of coffee I believed my wife would like in the morning, set a timer for 15-20 mins before her alarm would go off, and go to bed at peace with the little act of service for my spouse. In 2020, as the world slowed down and life pivoted to more time at home, I found myself changing routines and habits.

I decided to start getting up before my wife and pouring her a cup of coffee and mine as well. It's that little bit of time spent with her before the kids get out of bed. Sometimes we’d chat about the previous day, sometimes about the day coming up. We’d both spend time in The Word and we might discuss something of interest that God had laid out for us. I go to bed at night now, looking forward to my coffee and time with my wife.

Everywhere in Nebraska something similar to my story is happening in the morning. A cup of coffee, brewed and dispensed in a familiar cup or thermos. Those cups and thermos have have a connection to the person who gave it or the place you got it from. Usually, the message on the cup says something of importance to your life. You probably have a specific spot where you drink your coffee...that certain chair, couch, desk, or outdoor option. In many small towns across Nebraska, there is a local spot like VFW’s or the fire department or the general store or local gas station where the “early risers” go and share the gossip of the week (sometimes repeated EVERY day). If you buy your coffee cup from a chain business, I guarantee you have an opinion on who has “the best” coffee. And sometimes, you might spoil yourself and go to one of the specialty coffee businesses and get lattes or cappuccinos, flavored like a candy bar or iced because it's trendy & chic!

Eventually, we Nebraskans get on with the work of our day. We finish putting on the blue collar, white collar, plaid collar, scrub collar...whatever uniform or clothing appropriate for the day. As we go throughout our day we want to get out of the day, what we put into it. Yet, throughout the day we receive little...distractions...of what's “happening” in the world or our communities. We become engaged in the content of "news". This content might come from your local media, or social media, or even text/chat conversations, but regardless we are now distracted with something that usually has a level of importance that creates a Call to Action. A moment or thought, where you say, “I’ve gotta do something about this. I’ve gotta say something about this. I’ve gotta make others aware or I’ve gotta find a solution!”

_**“I’ve gotta DO something!”**_

This is where the message of my first newsletter comes to you today. You are right...with what is happening in our World, with what is happening in our communities...**you’ve** gotta do something.

You have to say; “enough is enough”.

What happens next in the Call to Action is up to you. This is what I did in 2020...I believed that my voice and skill sets could make an impact and have influence to promote or effect change not only within the Republican party, but within my community. I said, “enough is enough”. I then surrounded myself with strong, passionate individuals who are becoming the leaders of the NEGOP.

Join me.
Join the hundreds of NEGOP leaders, who have said “enough is enough”. Join your local county party or local active political groups. ENGAGE others in dialogue and discussion that increases your knowledge and awareness of the Republican party’s governing apparatus.

_Don't_ post on Facebook.
_Don’t_ Twitter tweet. (or whatever Elon is calling it now)
_Don’t_ send “You should...” emails to elected officials.
_Don’t_ sit and fume about the way things “should be done”.

**Go** to County Party meetings
**Go** to School Board meetings
**Go** to City Council meetings
**Speak** with confidence and knowledge, passion and articulation at county party, school board, and city council meetings.
**Speak** with others at your church or community organizations.
**Become** a county delegate in 2024 ****The NEGOP can show you how** **
**Become** an elected member of your County Party ****The NEGOP can show you how****
**Become** an elected member of the State Party ****The NEGOP can show you how**
Become** a candidate for your local school board and _really_ have an impact on your community ****The NEGOP can show you how****
**Become** a candidate for your city council, village board, NRD, ESU, county boards, community college boards, or energy boards. ****The NEGOP can show you how****

There are over _**900 elected Democrats**_ in the State of Nebraska and they are almost **ALL** at your local political entities. They ARE on your local school boards allowing pornography in the libraries and they ARE telling YOU it's YOUR fault if kids aren’t parented correctly to know right from wrong. They are telling you it’s YOUR fault Nebraska's students have below 50% proficiency scores in Reading, Writing, Math, & Science. They are telling you it’s YOUR fault that kids don’t care about America, or Patriotism or Civic Duties.

Republicans, we CARE for students and teachers.

We need to show teachers how much we support them and their love of educating our children. We want teachers to be successful, so our kids can have a future. When a child loves reading their whole future is brighter. Republicans, our local school systems NEED you NOW!

This is your Call to Action - Join, Go, Speak, Become...**DO** and know that the NEGOP will be there to provide the resources and support you need.

I truly hope this letter finds you well on this Monday morning. I hope you are encouraged throughout your day to make an impact in your communities at work, home, or school. I pray that your day is blessed and bears much fruit. Please enjoy the other sections of this newsletter as I will strive to bring forth purposeful content and featured leaders of Nebraska.

With much blessings,
---
|
---
| –Chairman Underwood
