## Spotlight Feature: From Rep Loren Lippincott
---
| Recently I watched the movie “The Sound of Freedom,” which, appropriately enough, was released on Independence Day. The movie bested the Indiana Jones movie that week, which says Americans long for movies that are true life stories of good triumphing over evil. The movie portrayed an American government official who tracked down a kidnapped young son and daughter. The children’s father was tricked by a woman who told him the kids were attending a day-long audition for parts in a movie. When the father came to pick them up at the end of the day, he found only an empty building.

The American agent, played by Jim Caviezel, went to great lengths to recover the children. The movie will leave you sober, saddened, and distraught at the depths of the depravity of mankind.

The true story the film is based on took place beyond our southern border. We tell ourselves those things do not happen here, but they do! We have even had several incidents of human trafficking in the 34th Legislative District recently! Twenty-seven percent of those trafficked are children. They are mostly used for labor, but some are sold as sex slaves. Of the children trafficked, 66 percent are girls.

Overall, Nebraska has seen 92 prosecutions for human trafficking for labor and sex slavery, with 88 of those prosecutions in just the past seven years. Furthermore, this is happening more often, aided and abetted by the current administration’s loose open-border policies. Since President Biden took office, the number of illegals crossing our southern border has increased fivefold. According to Customs and Border Patrol agents, nearly 2.5 million illegals cross our border yearly.

According to a Massachusetts Institute of Technology Operational Data Simulation (performed one million times), there are now 16-29 million illegals in the United States. In Biden’s first five months alone, five million illegals crossed our southern border, and soon one-tenth of our entire population will consist of illegals.

Reports show many of these individuals are single, military-age men, inmates from foreign prisons, gang members, known terrorists, and unaccompanied minors. Many women are raped during their journey to illegal entry into our country.

During my time at Delta Airlines, based in Atlanta, Georgia -- home of the world’s busiest airport -- the company would brief us on what to look for in passengers who were possibly trafficking minors or young adults on our aircraft. The flight attendants would be vigilant in looking for anything suspicious while serving the customers. Though I never encountered this on one of my flights, I knew of traffickers apprehended from other Delta flights.

Trafficking is a despicable and reprehensible crime! Forcibly abusing another person against their will for your pleasure or profit is heinous.

What can you, as an individual American do? Keep your eyes and ears open for suspicious behavior that might suggest enslavement. Worldwide, slavery is more widespread now than at any time in history. Our borders are extremely porous, and we are a marketplace with money. Our State Attorney General Mike Hilgers has set up a Human Trafficking Hotline at 888-373-7888. Don’t hesitate to call it if you see something suspicious. Consider joining the ministry of helping trafficked people get back on their feet after being set free. You can volunteer with the State Department of Health and Human Services at 402-471-3121.

But to start with, get informed. Make it a point to see The Sound of Freedom while it is playing in local theaters. It is well worth watching. In the closing credits of the movie, Caviezel tells of the struggle Angel Studios had in bringing the movie to theaters. It took five years of fighting marketplace forces that did not want the truth of this movie to be shown to Americans. This film clearly shows the anguish of children being separated from their families and the evils of those who enslave them. But it also shows how one brave and courageous man, empowered and guided by the hand of God, can prevail against the odds.

Loren Lippincott was born in Central City, Nebraska. Lippincott graduated from Central City Public Schools in 1973. He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1980 to 1990 as an F-16 fighter pilot and instructor. Lippincott earned a B.S. in broadcast journalism from the University of Nebraska in 1978. His career experience includes working as a farmer, newscaster, and commercial pilot. Lippincott became a member of the Nebraska Farm Bureau and the National Rifle Association (NRA)

| | | It's Marco. Please read this message to the end, but only if you’re prepared to handle the reality of our situation. With only about 30% of folks opening these messages, I believe that by opening this, you’re someone who can handle it. I know it's hard to tell fact from fiction these days, but I’m going to level with you and tell you the truth.

On top of only about 30% of our friends opening these messages, only about 1% will go the extra mile by donating. Conservatives like me rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to raise money for our cause, so I'm humbly asking you to read this all the way through. If you still think your $1 doesn't matter, then I want to simply thank you for hearing me out.

**Here's the truth...**

The Democrats stopped our Red Wave in 2022, and we need every little bit if we want to fund the programs needed to win in 2024 - and we need it today.

I don't have deep-pocketed billionaires I can call on to hit these goals. I rely on a couple of bucks here and there from hard-working Americans receiving these messages when they can afford it.

**If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit, we would be able to reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' millions raised. I know it's not much, but all I need from you today is the price of a cup of coffee, a candy bar, or a donut.**

_Democrats are hoping I give up on you.

We can't let them run this country into the ground. I'm rolling up my sleeves and continuing to fight for hard-working families like yours - making our country better, stronger, and safer.

_I hope you don't give up on me or our shared values._ A lot of folks are going to ignore this, but I need patriots like you to see what's at stake if you ignore this.

**If you think you're better off than you were 5 years ago, then I understand why you don't want to donate today.**
**But if you think we need to get this country back on track and the American Dream restored, please donate whatever you can afford by midnight!**

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Who rules whom?
body:
The Constitution established a limited government in which the people ruled through their elected officials.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z16vvn0lvqr0hhsr9bjoekot4srn2652a2ek2pk8_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3j60o32c9h2bs)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zcm0c001k1pf45900tsartuogdqv0s6k9gief0go_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3j60o32c9h2bs).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0kamcii5vn5qa1ko5b22fjufbor1bjrvd0ba28g_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3j60o32c9h2bs)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**P.S.** I look forward to receiving your opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that you can support our work.

So please complete the **National Referendum on the Administrative State** using this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6qndm0uaqf5elqmvbmnmk4chai7g193h49in37g_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3j60o32c9h2bs)**

As soon as you respond, we will begin your FREE lifetime subscription to _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication through postal mail.

Educating millions about the Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your commitment to liberty.
---
| | Hillsdale College 33 East College St Hillsdale, MI 49242 USA

body:
Please read this message to the end, but only if you’re prepared to handle the reality of our situation.

| |
---
| | | It's Marco. Please read this message to the end, but only if you’re prepared to handle the reality of our situation. With only about 30% of folks opening these messages, I believe that by opening this, you’re someone who can handle it. I know it's hard to tell fact from fiction these days, but I’m going to level with you and tell you the truth.

On top of only about 30% of our friends opening these messages, only about 1% will go the extra mile by donating. Conservatives like me rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to raise money for our cause, so I'm humbly asking you to read this all the way through. If you still think your $1 doesn't matter, then I want to simply thank you for hearing me out.

**Here's the truth...**

The Democrats stopped our Red Wave in 2022, and we need every little bit if we want to fund the programs needed to win in 2024 - and we need it today.

I don't have deep-pocketed billionaires I can call on to hit these goals. I rely on a couple of bucks here and there from hard-working Americans receiving these messages when they can afford it.

**If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit, we would be able to reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' millions raised. I know it's not much, but all I need from you today is the price of a cup of coffee, a candy bar, or a donut.**

The way we see it, we have two options today if we're going to close the gap. Either we...

body:
C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history.

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3fee1f675a441ea8c742af588d36b39&_e=dnzIe3cvYQ8tTWzG_3sOiAEKAXoDPMEAgvmT60rt2pJriIxb18q0FWv1BEaKmvMv7GTBy8C-NBPwSLaAuzKkLFKqC5YAzYjs5K91y2DuAn6efTuZxnwYPHKhOAEMTp_N3dUetiITRz2WQ4bV8oqog5v-BFzREOfcDsOLs10VrYai12A-UaP4EvbLfMvZEw09NeoyrBKmTcIAR8JYqEgXGf3PeBjHxn05-5bylZ5bsvHQTnAco8mHUIDYbSNEAWLStRhEYy56xFFG_XK00gIl1oy2y_f2tmOtVRQW1IwSkWdVeRTuwCmco-9bmCLHsEC4VjEC7lNCtCoOy4j4BfaUFN989D7rBXtKzqp2Gp91PIdIb8civXreryaF318rhxOya34bXDEAam21-rlwngsLCt-wqTV-4weRGiFu6KoXogfFZYqGcLdj37Tuor85a6Do) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I'm writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News _because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--like our free online courses. _ _ And though we're best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author--C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **"[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3fee1f675a441ea8c742af588d36b39&_e=dnzIe3cvYQ8tTWzG_3sOiAEKAXoDPMEAgvmT60rt2pJriIxb18q0FWv1BEaKmvMv7GTBy8C-NBPwSLaAuzKkLFKqC5YAzYjs5K91y2DuAn6efTuZxnwYPHKhOAEMTp_N3dUetiITRz2WQ4bV8oqog5v-BFzREOfcDsOLs10VrYai12A-UaP4EvbLfMvZEw09NeoyrBKmTcIAR8JYqEgXGf3PeBjHxn05-5bylZ5bsvHQTnAco8mHUIDYbSNEAWLStRhEYy56xFFG_XK00gIl1oy2y_f2tmOtVRQW1IwSkWdYrCoQmIMBQtpIoyO4yCid7SJFORwc0VBvA_7PIuJfcEvBCF-9lYykTb5fdfDjl2adRvYRVY_Gp3S_QfasqUjF5vCOwi6AnntPiTD94sp_ZGywjBGgZ6mmqHvShQGHapE1dJXppsRsLOFHCyfcD62-)" **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That's why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **"[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3fee1f675a441ea8c742af588d36b39&_e=dnzIe3cvYQ8tTWzG_3sOiAEKAXoDPMEAgvmT60rt2pJriIxb18q0FWv1BEaKmvMv7GTBy8C-NBPwSLaAuzKkLFKqC5YAzYjs5K91y2DuAn6efTuZxnwYPHKhOAEMTp_N3dUetiITRz2WQ4bV8oqog5v-BFzREOfcDsOLs10VrYai12A-UaP4EvbLfMvZEw09NeoyrBKmTcIAR8JYqEgXGf3PeBjHxn05-5bylZ5bsvHQTnAco8mHUIDYbSNEAWLStRhEYy56xFFG_XK00gIl1oy2y_f2tmOtVRQW1IwSkWf-pw0bGnabxaX_5xKUyW899AvhXXbfSeM0dnmclN4rJdM49P-5jwenrzED88RVDnlQ7Z9iMn00I1otMDFONBaK_DovhuhcY5tKnHxoAzx-uEojeVt0ANuP_3aU_IiR83OBA9j5RqJn_LYs68Mu00nB)," **we've received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis' writings. [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3fee1f675a441ea8c742af588d36b39&_e=dnzIe3cvYQ8tTWzG_3sOiAEKAXoDPMEAgvmT60rt2pJriIxb18q0FWv1BEaKmvMv7GTBy8C-NBPwSLaAuzKkLFKqC5YAzYjs5K91y2DuAn6efTuZxnwYPHKhOAEMTp_N3dUetiITRz2WQ4bV8oqog5v-BFzREOfcDsOLs10VrYai12A-UaP4EvbLfMvZEw09NeoyrBKmTcIAR8JYqEgXGf3PeBjHxn05-5bylZ5bsvHQTnAco8mHUIDYbSNEAWLStRhEYy56xFFG_XK00gIl1oy2y_f2tmOtVRQW1IwSkWfAAQ3QiTBV561Wcz7gtpWH52Kim6DQP5NQK1hUYSI6rxZtT6WmNa0IEotQW_fC6hzbzFKEyaVElQT3pk2LyizQvOReGC_DL0PZ7sTcAHLG0wwHJlzxMXdTqwfldPFL-fv7twy3livyGxGWTyCf8CDu) We've also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. clean_body: Summer is racing by on the campaign trail and there's no time to slow down. | | Fellow American, Summer is racing by on the campaign trail and there's no time to slow down. Over the past couple of months, we have experienced unstoppable momentum. Last week in New Hampshire, I unveiled my comprehensive plan to shut down the administrative state, which gained widespread attention and support. Polls now show us solidly in 3rd place - and rapidly ascending. | But there's no resting on our laurels. I've been crisscrossing the country, tirelessly campaigning and connecting with people from all walks of life. Together, we're building a movement that's stronger than ever before. We have qualified for the first Presidential GOP Debate, but now we are trying to make sure we have a prime spot on the debate stage. That's why this end-of-month deadline is absolutely crucial. It marks the last deadline before the upcoming debate. It's vital to maintain the momentum in spreading the message of TRUTH. Thank you, Vivek Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. | | | It's Marco. Please read this message to the end, but only if you're prepared to handle the reality of our situation. With only about 30% of folks opening these messages, I believe that by opening this, you're someone who can handle it. I know it's hard to tell fact from fiction these days, but I'm going to level with you and tell you the truth.

On top of only about 30% of our friends opening these messages, only about 1% will go the extra mile by donating. Conservatives like me rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to raise money for our cause, so I'm humbly asking you to read this all the way through. If you still think your $1 doesn't matter, then I want to simply thank you for hearing me out.

**Here's the truth...**

The Democrats stopped our Red Wave in 2022, and we need every little bit if we want to fund the programs needed to win in 2024 - and we need it today.

I don't have deep-pocketed billionaires I can call on to hit these goals. I rely on a couple of bucks here and there from hard-working Americans receiving these messages when they can afford it.

**If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit, we would be able to reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' millions raised. I know it's not much, but all I need from you today is the price of a cup of coffee, a candy bar, or a donut.**

# Friend — **I’m no politician. I spent my career in law enforcement and the military. **
---
I started out as a beat cop for the Atlanta Police Department. I went on to become Doraville’s chief of police. I enlisted in the Army National Guard because I wanted to serve the country that’s given me so much. I joined as a private. Earlier this year, I retired as a major general.
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/51a797e4f41bbbc57c94c760ea83e7c0/41703/01b4492be17641f0/646af73873e19a84c3d6b838967d376c/41703)
---
**Today, I’m proud to serve as Georgia’s first Hispanic statewide elected official.** Politics was never on my radar. But when Governor Kemp asked me to step in and clean up the Georgia Department of Insurance, I answered the call — and last year, the people of Georgia gave me a full term to finish the job.
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/51a797e4f41bbbc57c94c760ea83e7c0/41703/01b4492be17641f0/4970ae9f8a1084e6c3d6b838967d376c/41703)
---
**I’ve spent my career taking action, making tough choices, and delivering results — not paying lip service to problems without doing anything to solve them.** That’s what I’m continuing to do as Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner. We’re protecting families, cracking down on fraud, and holding the powerful accountable. **Because I haven’t spent my career in politics, I depend on folks chipping in a few bucks whenever they can to keep up the fight, and to share my message and story.** **[If you can, will you pitch in $24 — or even just $8 — right now? Doing so will help us keep our foot on the gas.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/51a797e4f41bbbc57c94c760ea83e7c0/41703/01b4492be17641f0/ad002e22f4e9c5a4c3d6b838967d376c/41703)** Thank you for any support you can give.

---
Commissioner John King got his start as a beat cop with the Atlanta Police Department. He worked various assignments, including Red Dog and Organized Crime, before joining the Doraville Police Department. Before becoming Chief of Police, he served as a Detective and Deputy Chief. During his 17 years as Police Chief, Commissioner King tackled corruption, implemented community policing in at-risk neighborhoods, and cracked down on gang violence through early intervention programs at local schools. In addition to his career in law enforcement, Commissioner King spent four decades serving in the U.S. Army National Guard — enlisting as a private and retiring as a major general. He deployed to Bosnia, Iraq, and Afghanistan — earning the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, El Salvador gold medal for achievement, meritorious service medals, and a NATO award along the way. Commissioner King retired from active duty in 2023. As Georgia’s Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner, Commissioner King has disrupted the status quo, put Georgia families first, and held the powerful accountable. He was appointed by Governor Brian Kemp in 2019 and elected to a full term in 2022, making him Georgia’s first Hispanic statewide elected official.

Because I haven’t spent my career in politics, I depend on folks chipping in a few bucks whenever they can to keep up the fight, and to share my message and story. Thank you for any support you can give. John KingGeorgia Insurance Commissioner | | Commissioner John King got his start as a beat cop with the Atlanta Police Department. He worked various assignments, including Red Dog and Organized Crime, before joining the Doraville Police Department. Before becoming Chief of Police, he served as a Detective and Deputy Chief. During his 17 years as Police Chief, Commissioner King tackled corruption, implemented community policing in at-risk neighborhoods, and cracked down on gang violence through early intervention programs at local schools. In addition to his career in law enforcement, Commissioner King spent four decades serving in the U.S. Army National Guard — enlisting as a private and retiring as a major general. He deployed to Bosnia, Iraq, and Afghanistan — earning the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, El Salvador gold medal for achievement, meritorious service medals, and a NATO award along the way. Commissioner King retired from active duty in 2023. As Georgia’s Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner, Commissioner King has disrupted the status quo, put Georgia families first, and held the powerful accountable. | | | Patriot Powerhouse KARI LAKE is coming to Mackinac!

You don't want to miss this.

MIGOP is thrilled to announce KARI LAKE as a featured speaker for our upcoming Mackinac Republican Leadership Conference. We are honored to host Kari who is one of our strongest advocates for Constitutional Values. Her story is compelling: The daughter of a teacher and a nurse, Kari grew up in Iowa alongside eight siblings and learned the value of a hard day's work. Enthralled by people's stories, Kari embarked on a prosperous 27-year media career before finding her voice in speaking truth to power and eventually distancing herself from the mainstream media she once embraced. In 2022, Kari ran for Governor of Arizona with the endorsement of President Donald J. Trump on a platform of putting Arizona First. A tireless fighter, Kari believes in what all do: secure borders, energy independence, safe streets, education not indoctrination, and pushing back against the radical Biden agenda. Kari Lake is a voice for the silent majority and fights back against the relentless assault on our freedoms by the radical left. She is a true original. Come see her live for her inspirational message! You’ll be glad you did. For additional details about our Mackinac Island Conference, please [click here.](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=a6f5433a19&e=a2af77507c)

We look forward to seeing you there.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:
Republicans are launching attack after attack against Pramila. It won't work.
#
Peter,
Republicans and the far right are launching attack after attack against Pramila for her tireless work and relentless fight for racial justice, gender justice, economic justice, and environmental justice.
But you can't bully Pramila Jayapal. She is not afraid to stand up for trans rights. She'll always be outspoken on human rights everywhere in the world. She will never back down in the fight for abortion access, gun safety, and taking on big corporate special interests who work against poor and working people.
Republicans will do anything to stop Pramila's fight for justice. But she'll never stop building a more powerful, diverse, and progressive movement. **Let's show her we have her back.**
>From her years as an organizer for immigrants' rights to her leadership in Congress to pass bold, visionary policy, Pramila has never let the cynics bring her down or stop her from doing what's right.
That's why we need to have her back, Peter. **[If you support Pramila's work to empower marginalized voices, please chip in today to power our movement.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42820?refcode=em20230731-2758&t=1&akid=2758%2E420207%2EF9FI2C)**
**[Chip in ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42820?refcode=em20230731-2758&t=20&akid=2758%2E420207%2EF9FI2C)**
Powerful special interests and extreme right-wing MAGA Republicans want Washington D.C. to keep working for them, while poor and working people in the United States and across the world continue to face an accelerating climate crisis, diminished fundamental rights, and an economy that doesn't work for them.
**Pramila knows we can't let that stand.**
Every day in Congress, Pramila fights for people who are too often taken advantage of, overlooked, or forgotten. It's not the easy way, but it's the only way that Pramila knows how to shake up the status quo and deliver for the people who most desperately need change. _She will always speak truth to power._
**Peter, now more than ever, we need to come together and use our collective voice to show our support for Pramila.****[If you stand with her, please chip in $3 or any amount you can spare to boost our momentum and power this fight.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42820?refcode=em20230731-2758&t=21&akid=2758%2E420207%2EF9FI2C)**
In solidarity,
Team Pramila

**The "Ohio Liberator Caucus"**

---
| If the Ohio Liberty Movement is going to be relevant, we must learn to love our freedom more than we love a candidate. In the 2022 primary election, we gave Joe Blystone and Jim Renacci more votes than Mike DeWine, but we lost because our votes were split. The**"Ohio Liberator Caucus** " will address this by bringing together delegates from Ohio's Liberty Groups to vote on endorsements prior to the 2024 primary. We will promote our slate card of endorsements to other like-minded Ohioans to create a voting bloc of people with our values. We can't afford another primary like 2022 because our freedom is at stake, and for 2024 the **Ohio Liberator Caucus (OLC) **is our best option.

* * *
---
| The plan for the OLC is to have a male & female delegate from each of the 33 Ohio Senate districts, totaling 66 delegates. They will meet in late 2023 to decide endorsements on candidates for: US President, US Senate, US House, Ohio Supreme Court, Ohio Senate, Ohio House, and Ohio Republican State Central Committee. **To make the OLC successful, we need a team to help with organizing the event in the areas of planning, logistics, candidate review, fundraising, and more.**

If you would be willing to consider participating in this first-of-its-kind event in Ohio, please send an email to **[GFIOhio@proton.me](mailto:GFIOhio@proton.me?subject=Ohio%20Liberator%20Caucus)** with your indication of interest & contact information.

Let us know if you have any questions or need more information.

subject: DACA’s never been enough
body:
We need your help to keep up the fight. | | | Hi Peter, I’m Axel. I’m a DACA recipient, and I joined United We Dream Action’s fight for permanent protections because my future and my family’s is on the line right now. While the program has given me many opportunities, it’s never been enough — especially for my mixed status family. When I moved to the U.S. with my parents from Honduras in 2005, DACA didn’t exist. DACA left out my parents, and most recently, left out one of my little sisters when her application, along with thousands of others, were never processed after Trump tried to end the program and a federal judge blocked new applications from being processed. I’ve seen firsthand through my own experiences and now my sister’s experiences how access to opportunities is impacted simply by being undocumented. **Citizenship is the only path forward, Peter, it’s as simple as that.** I traveled to D.C. along with hundreds of other immigrant youth last year to take action and fight for our future. Now, I’m asking you to stand up for our immigrant communities. **Will you make a donation today to help secure permanent protections for DACA recipients and immigrant youth like my sisters and me? clean_body: We need your help to keep up the fight. | | | Hi Peter, I’m Axel. I’m a DACA recipient, and I joined United We Dream Action’s fight for permanent protections because my future and my family’s is on the line right now. While the program has given me many opportunities, it’s never been enough — especially for my mixed status family. When I moved to the U.S. with my parents from Honduras in 2005, DACA didn’t exist. DACA left out my parents, and most recently, left out one of my little sisters when her application, along with thousands of others, were never processed after Trump tried to end the program and a federal judge blocked new applications from being processed. I’ve seen firsthand through my own experiences and now my sister’s experiences how access to opportunities is impacted simply by being undocumented. Citizenship is the only path forward, Peter, it’s as simple as that. I traveled to D.C. along with hundreds of other immigrant youth last year to take action and fight for our future. Now, I’m asking you to stand up for our immigrant communities. Will you make a donation today to help secure permanent protections for DACA recipients and immigrant youth like my sisters and me? Our deadline is about 12 hours away — and we need your help.
#
Peter — **is there anything we can say to get you to[add your first donation of any amount toward our end-of-month goal](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35301?refcode=em20230731-3481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3481%2E614464%2Et6HFAd) before midnight TONIGHT?**

# Summer Reflections
# from Warrior Mom
Summer has been busy here at Warrior Mom! We had some new beginnings, such as Noah getting his driver’s license, graduating high school and a God-baby was born. A new employee was hired to assist with projects that are steadily coming to fruition. Maintaining work-life balance is important, although it can be hard to do. Being in nature helps off-set the daily routine and allows for rejuvenation. The trails of Sundance and valleys of Yellowstone brought us much needed family time and tranquility (along with sore shoulders from ATV rides!). We now begin to wrap summer up, as we watch and support Noah transitioning into college life and adulthood. Thank you to my readers for your ongoing support, loyalty, and motivation as I continue on my Warrior Mom path...
Check out my social media pages for more Warrior Mom content.

clean_body: ... and looking ahead with Warrior Mom | | | | | | Summer Reflections from Warrior Mom Summer has been busy here at Warrior Mom! We had some new beginnings, such as Noah getting his driver’s license, graduating high school and a God-baby was born. A new employee was hired to assist with projects that are steadily coming to fruition. Maintaining work-life balance is important, although it can be hard to do. Being in nature helps off-set the daily routine and allows for rejuvenation. The trails of Sundance and valleys of Yellowstone brought us much needed family time and tranquility (along with sore shoulders from ATV rides!). We now begin to wrap summer up, as we watch and support Noah transitioning into college life and adulthood. Thank you to my readers for your ongoing support, loyalty, and motivation as I continue on my Warrior Mom path... | We need your help, team.

Tonight is a critical end-of-month fundraising deadline, and unfortunately, we are still $1,523 short of hitting our July fundraising goal.

As a nonprofit, we depend on grassroots support to continue our work. It has been humbling to see so many people believe in the mission of this organization and invest in our work since our founding in 2021. Because of your support, we helped deliver massive wins in 2022 and again earlier this year. Our community engagement staff have been on the ground since January registering Pennsylvanians to vote and talking with voters on the importance of making their voices heard in an “off-year” election. Now more than ever, we need your help to close our fundraising gap to keep up the momentum and build the foundation for 2024 and beyond.

[**That is why I am personally asking for your help. Team,

**It’s official:** Thanks in part to our hard work, Democrats currently hold a 480,000 voter registration advantage over Republicans in the Commonwealth.

In 2022, during our first full year of operations, we collected 20,000 voter registration forms, helped flip Pennsylvania's State House for the first time in more than a decade, and helped expand our U.S. Senate majority in the tight races in Pennsylvania AND Georgia.

**_We are here because Pennsylvanians deserve a reflective state legislature that prioritizes the needs of the community. But the work is not over yet._**

This November, we have an opportunity to elect local officials and statewide appellate court judges, including a new PA Supreme Court justice who will defend us from the far-right’s plans to disenfranchise voters and suppress votes. But first, this September, we will have the opportunity to maintain our hard-earned control of the state House.

| | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Sun Reader,
---
| | In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

subject: Why I’m asking you for a donation right now
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends, I’m going to be really honest with you right now. I know that may be rare to find in your inbox these days, so brace yourself:
I know it can sound a little absurd on the surface to be asking you to make a $5 donation in July, more than a year before the election, and especially when I come from enough privilege to be able to help support my own campaign.
(And yes - I have and will continue to take on as much budget responsibility as I can in order to make this campaign possible.)
But the truth is that no candidate - not even the billionaires we’ve seen run in recent years - can simply snap their fingers and create a successful campaign.
At the end of the day, transferring funds isn’t what makes that happen.
Building real, meaningful connections and a community of support - among as large a group of people as possible - is what matters. Empowering people to have a stake in their government is what matters. Bringing people together around shared values and big, mutual goals is what matters.
I need your support. If I'm serious about what I do - and trust me, I am - then I need to keep building this community and keep making sure every one of you is a part of this work in whatever way you can be.
If you can be a part of it by making a donation to fund the work we’re doing - putting campaign staff on the ground, creating more community outreach, fighting like hell to flip the House in 2024 - that would mean the world to me. ( You can do that by clicking here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] )
If you can’t right now, I understand - and I really appreciate your reading these emails and staying in touch!
Thank you so much for everything you do.
-Sara

Gov. Katie Hobbs here. Today, I’m asking you to join me in donating to the ADLCC to help build a better Arizona.
Click here to rush a donation before the ADLCC’s end-of-month fundraising deadline >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/adlcc2024?refcode=X_073123_Hobbs_d]

I ran my campaign on a pledge: to be a governor for all Arizonans – and, I’m doing just that as our administration strives to build a better future for Arizona. But, time and time again, it’s clear that our legislature’s Republican majority isn’t interested in working together – even if it comes at the cost of everyday Arizonans.
Between threatening to sue me for protecting LGBTQ+ Arizonans, further dismantling our reproductive rights, and refusing to get to work on our housing and transportation issues, this is the most extreme legislature in Arizona’s history.
That’s why now, more than ever, I am determined that we must flip the legislature in 2024.
As far-right Republican legislators continue to play games with Arizonans’ rights, I am grateful that Democratic legislators are working hard to push out tangible solutions for reproductive freedom, public education, and the future of Arizona’s water supply.
That said, we need a Democratic majority to truly make a difference.
If we want to see a Democratic majority come to fruition, we must work hard now to finally flip the legislature blue. Before the ADLCC’s end-of-month deadline, will you join me in supporting the ADLCC in that goal by donating now? Any amount will make a big difference. subject: How do you see the Supreme Court?
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| | This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z789ocbkamfibp2cu8trq9jh93jhaa0a62rf94lo_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm0o72c1h2bs)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhnd46jvsmjk3jailp31cit3n7c1uqh18ve47dqo_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm0o72c1h2bs) [NO](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze2r5pkde4n45ss2eragbbddkf8qba306sc25r28_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm0o72c1h2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5siea2m1pdbtrdcn53seb59q6a8kvdbnbqsgprg_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm0o72c1h2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuije2q4quophp6tqv2rr7fu1eb5agifm036beko_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm0o72c1h2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844
---
| | Hillsdale College 33 East College St Hillsdale, MI 49242 USA

---

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...

# Kari Lake Blew the Roof Off!
---
On Saturday night, our Constitutional Carry for Oregon (CCFO) grassroots group brought the fabulous Kari Lake to Salem. (I'm one of CCFO's chief petitioners.)

To call the event a success would be an understatement! We raised much-needed funds to help fight for our 2A rights in Oregon. Our team of volunteers deserve so much credit for pulling an event of this caliber off without a hitch.

_Kari brought the house down! _Her mention of President Trump alone raised a rally cheer from the audience like none I've seen at any event prior in this state. I think guests left with a sense of renewed hope.

If you haven't read Kari's new book, UNAFRAID, CCFO will offer autographed copies on the CCFO website soon. My own book, THE GOVERNMENT WE DESERVE, which was endorsed by Kari back in February, is available at [Black Lyon Publishing.](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/IZ8FvAjIqmiUH1gsOkBwrA~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRmqocIP0UgMDhiNzMzNzQ1YWFkOTZlODQ1YjBlNzFhMjI4ZjEzOGJEJGh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmJsYWNrbHlvbnB1Ymxpc2hpbmcuY29tL1cFc3BjZXVCCmS3CALIZPfxDV9SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAF9j) Copies purchased there for the next week are also signed, and I'm splitting profits for each copy sold with CCFO.

We're now a month into our year-long effort with 11 months of signature- gathering ahead of us. We will need things like mailings, paid circulators and television ads. Your donations go to concrete goals in this important cause.

I'm off to the Malheur County Fair this week. (I'll be there in the Republican booth on the 4th.) Next week, Solomon and I are headed to Josephine County. More on that later!

Will you rush in a donation before midnight to help us meet this monthly benchmark?

He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

The end of this month (midnight tonight) marks an important fundraising milestone in our campaign, and how we close will inform how much progress still needs to be made in our efforts to flip this seat. As you know, our race is poised to become one of the most competitive in the country. CA-27 is already being labeled, by Republicans and Democrats alike, as a true toss-up seat. That means what happens here will likely impact who controls the House majority. I’ll be honest, Peter, this fight isn’t going to be easy. We’re up against the last elected Republican representing Los Angeles County in Congress. You can bet Rep. Garcia will be calling on national Republicans to help bolster his campaign. We need new leadership in Washington, and I’m determined to do right by the people of the Santa Clarita and Antelope Valleys in Congress. Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, the NDRC’s fight for fairness is saving our democracy – and I mean that very literally. Together, we helped secure what the _New York Times_ called the fairest House map of the last generation ahead of last November’s elections. Now, thanks to the Supreme Court’s decision in _Allen v. Milligan_ , we have the opportunity to fight for _even fairer_ maps before 2024.

**That means our movement is facing a critical crossroads.** If we recommit to our fight for fairness, we can ensure the next election takes place on a level playing field and ensure our Democratic candidates have a fair chance at victory. But Republicans are fighting tooth and nail to preserve their gerrymanders and roll back our progress – and if we grow complacent, they could succeed.

**As Attorney General Eric Holder recently said, “Now is not the time to take our democracy for granted.”**

HiPeter,

I know you’ve been hearing from our team a lot lately, but we’re just hours away from a major deadline. Our July end of month deadline is coming up at midnight, and unfortunately, we’re still a few thousand dollars behind our digital fundraising goal.

**[If you can donate right now to help us catch up, I’d be so grateful, Peter.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67377876/419480310/535544092?amount=8&refcode=em_fr_2023.07.31_b1_yc_75do-no&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYmMwZTIwOS1kNzJmLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zzuCwi7LanpHmHaUWQg2aJL7OQ3GxtMPYC6_LY85rKk=)**

I know the election seems so far off, but my team is already making tough decisions that will shape the state of the race in November 2024. Whether or not we make this campaign goal will determine how many people my team can hire and how much we can spend on ads.

When I ran for Congress last year, I made the principled decision not to take a dollar of corporate PAC money. I’m representing YOU in Congress, not the corporate interests.

While it can be hard to rely on supporters just like you to pitch in every month, I’ve seen the strength of this grassroots movement up close in 2022. I know if we come together once again, we can meet every goal and keep Colorado’s 8th district Blue.

But you need to know this won’t be easy - not if we fall short now. Republicans spent millions last year attacking me. Kevin McCarthy is going to be watching to see if we can meet our goals, and I’m counting on you to show him that we can fight his corporate money with people power.

**[Peter, can you join this grassroots movement and pitch in $8 or whatever you can afford to help my reelection campaign and defeat the far-right?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67377877/419480311/535544092?amount=8&refcode=em_fr_2023.07.31_b1_yc_75do-no&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYmMwZTIwOS1kNzJmLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zzuCwi7LanpHmHaUWQg2aJL7OQ3GxtMPYC6_LY85rKk=)**

Thank you so much for your support, Peter. I can’t win this fight without you.

_Yadira Caraveo_

subject: Our country is facing a constitutional crisis
body:
The Constitution established a limited government in which the people ruled through their elected officials.

| | |
---
| | This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zcjb3r5s97m6vptlk4obmv8ie8mrg4j2sn60edt8_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm6oj2chh2bs)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgdbdlihseaqedl7ligurg8qnikfqkic39777vr8_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm6oj2chh2bs).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state--that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zqofdtvb7t7p1ael7bph5b2n523a9vfrf3lrv870_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm6oj2chh2bs) [NO](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zig6g6jgae792j7b9me2o3agtj6o1h7u614mov38_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm6oj2chh2bs) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb5covcbf3e4859qlehuj5un5kdsdu0dvttsp8qg_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm6oj2chh2bs)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: We're the richest country in the history of the planet. And still, families are struggling more and more each day while Republicans' rich donors boast about strong profit margins.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Here’s what happens when Republican politicians win elections and get their way: | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67389177/419525697/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ15T_EOM_E_20230731_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTcyMjk4Zi1mYTJmLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8XggGpEuuRvwofdJxN_t49I-k5eArP2TyC5F05a_A-Q=&emci=9872298f-fa2f-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=9972298f-fa2f-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=9027908)
---
Republicans love to say that they’re the party of “family values” — the party that looks out for parents and kids. Give me a break. Democrats are the ones fighting for paid family leave; quality, affordable child care; strong public schools for every family; good-paying jobs that leave parents with time to see their kids; and a government that works for every family, not just the rich and powerful. Meanwhile, here’s what happens when Republican politicians win elections and get their way:
* More people are forced to give birth because they can’t access contraceptives or abortion care. They’re disproportionately low-income. Disproportionately women of color. (And do Republicans have any plans to help those babies once they’re born? With, say, child care? Nope.)
* More parents are forced to ration groceries and watch their children go hungry.
* More parents are forced to have hushed conversations at the kitchen table after they’ve put their kids to bed — conversations about how on earth they’re going to make rent, pay the mortgage, or cover medical bills.
* More parents — especially moms — are forced to give up their careers because child care costs more than their salary.
* More parents are forced to make impossible choices between going to work that day so they can buy groceries or staying home so they can take care of a sick child.
* More kids are forced to go to under-funded public schools, where some get cruelly punished for having little to no funds in their lunch accounts.
* More teachers are forced to deal with red tape that stops them from teaching honest lessons about Black history, or from trying to create safe, welcoming classroom environments for LGBTQ+ students.
* More working people and more retirees are forced to struggle to make ends meet and afford life-saving prescription drugs.

**We're the richest country in the history of the planet. And still, families are struggling more and more each day while Republicans** ’** rich donors boast about strong profit margins. ** **I’m not willing to accept any of this. I’m fighting my heart out to pass plans that actually help working families and fight back against the GOP’s damage. ** **[Will you pitch in $20 or anything you can to power this fight before July’s midnight fundraising deadline tonight? I’m running for re-election to keep making big, structural change. But I can’t do this without your support.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67389178/419525698/-1332346508?amount=20&refcode=EMZ15T_EOM_E_20230731_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTcyMjk4Zi1mYTJmLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8XggGpEuuRvwofdJxN_t49I-k5eArP2TyC5F05a_A-Q=)** I never expect you to donate to every email, but I wanted to ask before our important monthly fundraising deadline tonight at midnight, in case a financial contribution would make sense for you right now. clean_body: Here’s what happens when Republican politicians win elections and get their way: | | | Republicans love to say that they’re the party of “family values” — the party that looks out for parents and kids. Meanwhile, here’s what happens when Republican politicians win elections and get their way: More people are forced to give birth because they can’t access contraceptives or abortion care. They’re disproportionately low-income. Disproportionately women of color. (And do Republicans have any plans to help those babies once they’re born? With, say, child care? Nope.) More parents are forced to ration groceries and watch their children go hungry. More parents are forced to have hushed conversations at the kitchen table after they’ve put their kids to bed — conversations about how on earth they’re going to make rent, pay the mortgage, or cover medical bills. More parents — especially moms — are forced to give up their careers because child care costs more than their salary. More parents are forced to make impossible choices between going to work that day so they can buy groceries or staying home so they can take care of a sick child. More kids are forced to go to under-funded public schools, where some get cruelly punished for having little to no funds in their lunch accounts. More teachers are forced to deal with red tape that stops them from teaching honest lessons about Black history, or from trying to create safe, welcoming classroom environments for LGBTQ+ students. More working people and more retirees are forced to struggle to make ends meet and afford life-saving prescription drugs. We're the richest country in the history of the planet. | | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zk8gpbf4aaqg2a3ia7aubbbbs47isnssqqilh6o8_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm6oj2chh2bs).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state--that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za8a2rl0j5knt98gkehmcbmt81br18ga4q9m1hco_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm6oj2chh2bs) [NO](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2er0kuukbjraesntqgudrqg3ttplokr4ajtv3bo_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm6oj2chh2bs) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6kbtf1ulmcnvq225lg6ghhk61gdj9ac0vui09po_rp22sh2s8i66p70c3gm6oj2chh2bs)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Tonight is another important deadline for our team, so I’m writing to you to ask for your help one last time this month. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230731?refcode=folf230731]
And the reason I am doing that is because the stakes for the 2024 elections could not be higher. We have just witnessed in the month of July the chaos and cruelty of House Republican policies and politics: from the National Defense Authorization bill, where Republicans added provisions to prohibit women service members from getting reproductive health care they need, to the annual appropriations process, where House Republicans directed massive cuts to programs that working families are counting on, like child care, education, health care, job training, and even public safety.
