# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=3210%2E5257348%2EuTabyZ)
Derek — we know it’s a Monday, so we won’t keep you for long.
In recent weeks, MAGA Republicans have made it clear that Adam is their number one target — and that they’re prepared to do anything and spend whatever it takes to keep him out of the Senate.

name: Cornel West 24
subject: Urgent! Need your help to get on the ballot.
body:
As you know, challenging the ruling elites' stranglehold on power depends entirely on getting on the ballot.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest24.org/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=071423_fundraiser1b&n=1)
---
Dear Peter - Thank you so much for being part of Dr. Cornel West's people-powered rebellion for truth, justice and love. As you know, challenging the ruling elites' stranglehold on power depends entirely on getting on the ballot. [Dr. West urgently needs your financial support today](https://www.cornelwest24.org/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=071423_fundraiser1b&n=2) to make this happen! While early ballot drives are underway or close to launch in 10 states, one of the earliest and most oppressive deadlines is in Arizona, which has one of the most prohibitive ballot access rules in the 50 states. While Democratic and Republican nominees automatically appear on its ballot, Arizona keeps competition off by requiring a staggering 37,000 "valid" signatures for third party access (which means collecting ~60,000 signatures to ensure we meet the "valid" threshold). And these are required within a near-impossible three month deadline this November when ballot access will be shut down! Because of the draconian timeline, we must jump start the process NOW with professional petitioners committed to the movement - while we organize and train volunteers to help. We’ll need to pay these professional petitioners $27,000 _ this week_ to get started! [Please throw $15, $25 or whatever you can into the hat](https://www.cornelwest24.org/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=071423_fundraiser1b&n=3). Your support at this critical moment is essential to break through ballot barriers intended to lock grassroots voices out of this election. Let's keep sending hope into the hearts of poor and working people, and shock waves into the political elites whose stranglehold on power is slipping fast. As inequality soars, climate chaos accelerates, and global conflict escalates under the parties of war and Wall Street, Cornel West's revolution for people, planet and peace can't come soon enough! In gratitude and solidarity, Team Cornel West PS: Stay tuned for a ballot access page coming to [cornelwest24.org](https://www.cornelwest24.org/r?u=xbOruBcx8X6cQKKqH8FxRjm3Dwl6jqPIFcEL97zPAqE&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=071423_fundraiser1b&n=4) in early August to keep you informed about the exciting battles ahead. [](https://www.cornelwest24.org/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=071423_fundraiser1b&n=5)[https://www.cornelwest24.org/](https://www.cornelwest24.org/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=071423_fundraiser1b&n=6)

body:
https://www.gabeamo.com/ [https://www.gabeamo.com/]

Friend,

July is the last full month before voting begins on August 16th, and tomorrow, my team and I will be making final budget decisions for this campaign. To ensure that we have the resources to be competitive, and ultimately victorious, on September 5th, I wanted to provide you with a few budget updates.

📺A few weeks ago, we placed a $225,000 ad buy.
🪧We spent over $5,300 to get union-printed yard signs.
👥 Our field staff is continuing to run an aggressive program including knocking on doors, making phone calls, and sending texts.

Our campaign is firing on all cylinders: we are continuing to host meet-and-greets, coffee conversations, and #GabeOnTheRhode tours across Rhode Island’s First Congressional District.

But, just last week, one of our opponents who is self-funding his campaign announced that he was moving up his ad buy on television, while an outside group announced that they were going to be spending over $300,000 alone on television on behalf of the Lieutenant Governor.

Rhode Islanders deserve a congressperson they can trust and who can deliver from day one. We’ve built a grassroots campaign that is organizing and building support for our campaign in every corner of the First Congressional District.

We are $9,857 short of our July fundraising goal. Can you chip in before midnight tonight to keep our campaign fundraising strong and our ad on the airwaves?

| Hi Derek, I know you heard from my team a lot this weekend, so first and foremost I want to thank you for sticking with us. I’m running a grassroots-funded campaign, which means your support is what keeps us running strong – so thank you for being part of my team.

Tonight is an important deadline in our fight to keep PA-17 blue, and I hope you’ll chip in whatever you can to help us reach our fundraising goal and keep our operation running strong.

This is how we restore our American economy.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=a2d6bc840c134056afdbff73fa28d868&_e=ZX_zcVsnurktr1DrzQOjncyC2KI864CeYAgrQTwCmvwZFNJ8G8WVawqfQ8WlfxB-tZnjwH6lbXAFFtCpGSzyBSiPyt4QI69DewJfm19PaCF9hrA2y5OuZoKo50Kt_tpkts70xf-SfyvWpU89ju0pTuCa8ZpQqCn0hriIFf_o6n8vobfc7ByNLcAlCiIsCwk2sXK4uVPft3nM0xvR-dSEt7EgGAVAziIC7d7JxMUZXP1XNpwaROA7eKORCswfeqzgBicv0bLLv4O4KiHiZADFBt2R20HDR_tgWmqE7RCXI886vPEBur6mZoFVVhgxo_p1oYHzT4Ogl52R_TNu6NmhjOERnAueaYedCbP8kFOmlKi52KA2nom4Pjc5jIxO_zKH4PcCwvbRRihKqXbf8-BikHusYIHsgiPJwN5-lClYQjtfOmWcZFLhXuEHahfbCgvF-ySc1IpXrakr_7CZAyVbuxIEzaV_Tm_9eIjnbfyMsUICpWcPzJG0NxPaeIx_Ut9N6PwOjIBEQYvlMmzejBCC6w%3D%3D)
---
Friend, We are letting the American Dream slip away. Day by day, I have watched it become harder for people to make the most of their God-given abilities and do well in our country. Today, I'm sharing with you my plan to address the suffering that the Harris-Biden administration has imposed on hardworking Americans. Friend, a big part of our Great American Comeback will be establishing our **_Declaration of Economic Independence_.** Our economy WILL be restored. This will be done, starting on day one, by focusing on 10 key points:
---
| [](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=a2d6bc840c134056afdbff73fa28d868&_e=ZX_zcVsnurktr1DrzQOjncyC2KI864CeYAgrQTwCmvwZFNJ8G8WVawqfQ8WlfxB-tZnjwH6lbXAFFtCpGSzyBSiPyt4QI69DewJfm19PaCF9hrA2y5OuZoKo50Kt_tpkts70xf-SfyvWpU89ju0pTuCa8ZpQqCn0hriIFf_o6n8vobfc7ByNLcAlCiIsCwk2sXK4uVPft3nM0xvR-dSEt7EgGAVAziIC7d7JxMUZXP1XNpwaROA7eKORCswfeqzgBicv0bLLv4O4KiHiZADFBt2R20HDR_tgWmqE7RCXI886vPEBur6mZoFVVhgxo_p1oYHzT4Ogl52R_TNu6NmhjOERnAueaYedCbP8kFOmlKgtcN7SUYoJ6wQI7Ql8kdfSFPJhBZHbWiIVPQZ6mnFLUqKIcxS_0HfOSzSjRA62pQNKw0p16pGRIeY2FuqbePNEX4QPYwNuKRMMULBYCTXA6PGm-noNnCR-O5JUBdF4qLXXUwLM6qQ8_SqTM1emHRMMbEsWA0HsdFiWDrCGDgMuGw%3D%3D)
---
My plan is to foster an economy where Americans are empowered to build, to own, and to support flourishing families and communities. My economic agenda will increase wages and productivity, and create jobs, while easing America's class divisions and unleashing a new era of growth, prosperity, and civic pride. **_Right now, we 're settling into persistently high prices with a very sluggish economy. Our growth rate in the past decade has been anemic. It's time to get growing again. _** At the end of the day, how we approach the economy is less about dollars and cents than it is about the type of society that we seek. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills

| This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=36def7dfce514d4589a9aeece59baf4f&_e=5zzh-ck9xHyqcmldskJIWoOg6twh-ya4m_2-fqCOk0dnYfi-ejLOhuAjnYbpejiA1s4JgdyIqGWrMd7D4Ng3m27y55v2ULdLuwMEpnKF63BKAf_p2PhvLS9wgjjE8EHXe5J3DQF5KvUNXSoQUpZZ86MiXQPhyNNQOF71JOrGUG_0i_MOudLdh-dA28AvopBSJps9BOyYnjh5QR26aIL1eqO1LGF2Qe8dG6iR1I4REceY4qWMkxTvy8ko_CM_nv3he1YthkucW_xIH28xSjYu11thaJx00jiSS4UwExZ4DmOLBV-o-_1EzsDhlf6XojIK2FbO6VO_kQkqC0eT0GxBbKBmAvR0Edfu-aqYjCNbk19LFTHzmVCdu_evUwD6GibShbgSEgxJ4HlZHXmQiKZAqPadqhFn6tu-MyL1NGQxyos%3D)
---
| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight." By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." ** Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** ** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.** Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because... Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight." By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." ** Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

And your gift matters even more because... body:
Hi Peter,

As a first-time candidate for Congress, I have to admit that my _least_ favorite part about running for office is the fundraising.

I don't believe money should play such an outsized role in who wins and loses. But regardless of how I feel about it, a critical piece of winning depends on raising awareness about my candidacy. Doing that takes resources.

Thanks to you, we have done an incredible job funding our efforts so far, and I’m proud to say that we have done it without a cent from corporate PACs.

Midnight tonight marks our July fundraising deadline, and we still need to raise about another $5,400 in grassroots contributions. Will you pitch in now to help us get to where we need to be?

You can use this quick link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jw-q3-23](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67383323/419503135/-129347026?refcode=em-7.31.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU2NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDJiNDFjZGEtZTgyZi1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jct6w17tXu3Bf2M30fCXgvLTfg4jshLkF9f5C1A1xgE=)**

Now that they are in power, extremists in the GOP demonstrate why it is critical to take back the House. Between freezing military funding to score ‘culture war’ points, to their near-daily attempts to restrict reproductive rights in this country, they have proven both out-of-touch and unfit to lead.

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

name: Joe Kent
subject: Marie Abandons Veterans
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund
body:
Dear Peter,
My opponent Democrat Marie Perez voted against fully funding Veterans Affairs.
She previously claimed that we need a "fully funded VA dedicated to serving veterans first." But she has gone back on yet another promise by voting in lockstep with Democrats against a bill to fund healthcare for our veterans.
I spent twenty years in the Special Forces, and I have first-hand experience with the VA system.
If you believe we need to send Republicans who will fight for our nation's veterans to Congress, please help me get to Washington by contributing to my campaign at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/4J7wpyf1TCgdl9cxt8Shnw/Eo6mqExMdcOrMzUQfFTMWA).
I support fully funding the VA and expanding access to Tricare to ensure those who fought for our nation receive healthcare.
I will fight for proper oversight of the VA. Our Congressional leadership needs people who know the system and understand how to navigate Veterans Affairs.
When I get to DC, I promise to fight for our veterans and work to improve access and funding to the VA.

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Sign The Petition: Polar bears are being crushed alive by Big Oil’s Arctic drilling machines
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1907426?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Big Oil’s drilling machines are running over and killing mama polar bears and cubs in their dens — and even burying them alive under snow!** [**Take urgent action now! >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1907427?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) _Friend, the oil and gas industry is destroying the Arctic with out of control drilling and fracking._ The region is already **warming 2x as fast** as the rest of the Earth, and the precious wildlife there is suffering the worst impacts of human-driven climate change. _**Walruses and polar bears are watching their ice habitat melt away so rapidly that experts believe the entire Arctic region could be ice-free by the year within the next 31 years!**_ And while these animals are clinging to survival, the fossil fuel industry continues to exploit the Arctic for profit. Drilling and fracking is not only terrible for the environment and increasing the rate of global warming, but it’s bringing in massive amounts of pollutants to the area and putting vulnerable polar bears at risk of being run over or buried by snow by giant drilling machines. If we’re going to _**STOP the fossil fuel industry from decimating what’s left of the Arctic**_ and defend the voiceless wildlife — like walruses and polar bears — who call the region home, we need to demand accountability NOW. [**Will you take urgent action today by adding your name to our petition calling for an END to increase oil and gas activity in the Arctic?**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1907428?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1907429?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
There are currently laws in place that require Big Oil to avoid known polar bear denning sites by at least one mile when drilling in the Arctic. But recent studies have shown _**MAJOR ERRORS**_ in the accuracy of the technology that’s used to detect these dens — where mama polar bears and cubs often burrow well beneath the snow’s surface.
The failure to properly detect denning sites puts innocent polar bears inside their dens at **HIGH RISK** of being _**RUN OVER and KILLED**_ by industrial-sized drilling machines — and even being _**BURIED ALIVE**_ under mounds of snow, _CRUSHING these helpless animals to death._
The Biden administration has recently approved a rule that permits even MORE oil and drilling activity in the Arctic despite the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service (FWS) findings that this increase has a 95% probability of resulting in _**SERIOUS INJURY OR DEATH**_ to Southern Beaufort polar bears who live there. With _only 900_ of these iconic bears remaining, these endangered mammals are the most imperiled polar bear population in the WORLD.
FWS has the authority to REJECT the new administrative rule and say NO to increased Big Oil harassment of harmless polar bears in the Arctic. But the agency isn’t going to act unless we demonstrate strong public support from environmentalists like you, so we’re asking for your urgent help today, Friend. Helpless polar bears _desperately_ need us to speak up for them before they are _**WIPED OUT**_ by Big Oil’s reckless drilling and fracking. Please help us get **3,921 more signatures by MIDNIGHT** to help _**SAVE endangered polar bears from Big Oil’s corporate greed.**_ [**Sign the petition and share with other activists NOW! >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1907430?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1907429?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Standing with you,
Marcie Keever
Oceans and Vessels Program Director,
Friends of the Earth**

body:
I couldn’t let the day get away from me without reaching out to humbly ask you to contribute to GIFFORDS PAC before our July deadline passes.
#

Hi there, Peter Ambler here.
As Executive Director of GIFFORDS, it’s my job to ensure that we’re on track to meet our fundraising goals. I just met with my team, and they told me we’re still not quite where we need to be to reach our July goals.
I know you’ve probably received a lot of emails today from candidates and organizations doing important work, and I don’t mean to clog your inbox. But I couldn’t let the day get away from me without reaching out to humbly ask you to contribute to GIFFORDS PAC before our July deadline passes.
**If you’re able to, you can use this link to make a contribution:**
[**https://go.giffords.org/go/July-2023**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july23.pfB_59&refcode=em230731-2-15&t=1&akid=6257%2E3935704%2EbGSmyh)
When you contribute to GIFFORDS PAC, every dollar goes towards our lifesaving work to elect gun safety champions up and down the ballot, research gun safety solutions, and help pass gun safety laws at the state, local, and federal level.
Ten years ago when we founded GIFFORDS, Gabby and I could have never imagined that our movement to end gun violence would be as strong as it is now. The politics around guns have changed drastically in recent years. Talking about gun safety used to be taboo—now it’s a winning issue. Make no mistake, that is largely due to the work we’ve done together.
But there’s still so much to be done. Gun violence is still at record high levels. We need you with us in the fight to pass more commonsense solutions to keep our communities safe.
[**So please, if you can, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC before our critical July fundraising deadline passes at midnight.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july23.pfB_59&refcode=em230731-2-15&t=2&akid=6257%2E3935704%2EbGSmyh)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july23.pfB_59&refcode=em230731-2-15&t=3&akid=6257%2E3935704%2EbGSmyh)**
Thank you for all that you do. Gabby and I are grateful to have you with us in this movement.
Sincerely,
Peter Ambler
Executive Director, GIFFORDS

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=6257%2E3935704%2EbGSmyh) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

**About Jim Jordan:** Leading the fight to hold Washington accountable.

**
In Washington, Jim Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies

In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility,and he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate.

As a state legislator, he took on the powerful special interests and the leaders from both political parties who wanted to put Ohio on an unsustainable path of higher taxes and spending.

To put it bluntly, we could be tracking to fall short.
#
Derek,
I'll be the first to admit this was NOT the email I hoped to send you with just a few hours until our end-of-month deadline.
But I'm worried our numbers just aren't where they need to be to hit our fundraising goal before midnight. **To put it bluntly, we could be tracking to fall short.**
While we expect donations to slow down a bit over the summer, we *still* haven't seen the uptick in online donations we were hoping to see this week. _And unless things turn around, that could pose a risk to our long-term plans to defend our blue Senate majority, especially PA’s seats._
Now, with just hours to go, there's realistically only one scenario in which we can make up for lost time, close our fundraising gap, and sustain John’s work:
**[I just crunched the numbers again, and we can still meet our goal before midnight if around 15 more folks from Cresco are able to chip in even a modest amount. Can I put you down for a last-minute $5 donation in these final, crucial hours?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230731-1?refcode=em20230731-1-8486&refcode2=8486_434096_4M5eZj&akid=8486%2E434096%2E4M5eZj)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230731-1?amount=5&refcode=em20230731-8486&refcode2=8486_434096_4M5eZj&akid=8486%2E434096%2E4M5eZj)**
According to your donor file, you have yet to make a contribution to John this month. If you've been considering showing your support, we'd deeply appreciate you stepping up in this big moment. It'd say a lot about how you're ready to have John's back.
**That's why I'm really hoping that you'll be among the 15 more folks from Cresco we need to donate — and that you'll dig deep and pitch in for the first time this month.**
**[If enough people like you decide to chip in before 11:59 p.m., we've got a real shot at closing the gap on our fundraising goal before we close the books on July. What do you say? Can you donate any amount before midnight?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230731-1?refcode=em20230731-1-8486&refcode2=8486_434096_4M5eZj&akid=8486%2E434096%2E4M5eZj)**
Thank you,
Eric 💙
Eric Stern
John Fetterman for U.S. Senate

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20230731-8486-footer&t=1&refcode2=8486_434096_4M5eZj&akid=8486%2E434096%2E4M5eZj)**

| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ee4dfe51265b49dc9ee5692d8f8cf13e&_e=DNHvqWeoclDNiU6Cm7fMyKvBB2meTzJiZzaBVnw7CvwjFb6ukFJwCoieu45MD1bFf7ryaw8vupR17fB9N-J0QA7_WonShdwgJlWxPO55kjszG30uq7FqsdqTWSw8Q6eCHVb1Kb0LP41JPknzUHq9lEDvMiylbW62EDXV_xuEZbhBQ6uncOFR1eOc9fsOM-WFIvagmTkSY23PFVlfwJWOwDFHh2HFtNMFnIdwlifuxZ70bpuFXAT3vGzXvTwpjyyS1Rl0uRZmkBFnojr2yjG7TSPFhzFHa1ofClbg5mkNLZqHI6AmkseTJ2CbSnytlmp-umZ7bA9ck1h9HDmTkbfIECVz0iWUIGu5D2MA3ELmH8DpEemAkQoIgmV5xWPNbIlMQFiS41LeBDfN1gyhxvk5a9CfyswCQdF7ahHhT2omqRQ%3D).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state--that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ee4dfe51265b49dc9ee5692d8f8cf13e&_e=DNHvqWeoclDNiU6Cm7fMyKvBB2meTzJiZzaBVnw7CvwjFb6ukFJwCoieu45MD1bFf7ryaw8vupR17fB9N-J0QA7_WonShdwgJlWxPO55kjszG30uq7FqsdqTWSw8Q6eCHVb1Kb0LP41JPknzUHq9lEDvMiylbW62EDXV_xuEZbhBQ6uncOFR1eOc9fsOM-WFIvagmTkSY23PFVlfwJWOwDFHh2HFtNMFnIdwlifuxZ70bpuFXAT3vGzXvTwpjyyS1Rl0uRZmkBFnojr2yjG7TTxANnDqFEBFzWo4j6W8y384v4LZ5QtCHJRxhnHVabIGYRKg5xTiLWYfMcptJ5wlt0ygI3bWxzHFGnsO2XSBpsVSkmnRI0anLERc9jJRS3UCxgC5pumvS-j59xdhRcfrhtdPMNvuubM2BjvRXEXQY14%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ee4dfe51265b49dc9ee5692d8f8cf13e&_e=DNHvqWeoclDNiU6Cm7fMyKvBB2meTzJiZzaBVnw7CvwjFb6ukFJwCoieu45MD1bFf7ryaw8vupR17fB9N-J0QA7_WonShdwgJlWxPO55kjszG30uq7FqsdqTWSw8Q6eCHVb1Kb0LP41JPknzUHq9lEDvMiylbW62EDXV_xuEZbhBQ6uncOFR1eOc9fsOM-WFIvagmTkSY23PFVlfwJWOwDFHh2HFtNMFnIdwlifuxZ70bpuFXAT3vGzXvTwpjyyS1Rl0uRZmkBFnojr2yjG7TfP28jxc8bc_FiLjTQ4WlXrWh7I4SHO-Jp5AVzhCSCviLn5439xwrS3UozvfdUSgk7owstzSmrGrnP5xgR8MwJUn84evGRddWM2DsxddsxWi3tGCxazhKIRbMhB2YS18mtXAn5VqfhvFs33zWVdSe7E%3D) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ee4dfe51265b49dc9ee5692d8f8cf13e&_e=DNHvqWeoclDNiU6Cm7fMyKvBB2meTzJiZzaBVnw7CvwjFb6ukFJwCoieu45MD1bFf7ryaw8vupR17fB9N-J0QA7_WonShdwgJlWxPO55kjszG30uq7FqsdqTWSw8Q6eCHVb1Kb0LP41JPknzUHq9lEDvMiylbW62EDXV_xuEZbhBQ6uncOFR1eOc9fsOM-WFIvagmTkSY23PFVlfwJWOwDFHh2HFtNMFnIdwlifuxZ70bpuFXAT3vGzXvTwpjyyS1Rl0uRZmkBFnojr2yjG7Tegpc-ho2rS_sZqo2a1jZCuQL7Mk1p772Lq8PwBF5uUiYKhrFEOOb5RThqU0nojfEr6golOXq9HOPU8fI7qT2uDwmqu3Ujp7vzZ4oyyqB4HT98SayLLIorJzAgBh9a9UJRTptRPjy5VKDR5FXfMlKZY%3D)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

Open your eyes to the agenda of the far left, prepare yourself for the fight on the horizon. We buried our heads in the sand long enough, believing that the government had our best interests in mind. Get in the fight with us! Go to your local school boards and demand the removal of all sexually explicit and immoral books in your children's curriculum and libraries.

If not YOU, WHO? If not NOW, WHEN? YOU were made for such a time as this!!

God Bless You and Semper Fi,
Dr. Cordie Williams
USMC Veteran

2. Support Candidates with Money, Fundraising people to hold events, provide a social media following for them, Church connections so they have a stage to reach the masses. We feel that candidates that have leverage are candidates that win. Get involved and become a CRA member and inquire about how you can help 1776 with the Coalition.

Affirming the dignity, agency, worth, and rights of people with disabilities. | |
---
Peter, July is Disability Pride Month, a celebration of disabled activists and an affirmation of the dignity, agency, worth, and rights of people with disabilities. **Today and every day, Cori Bush advocates for the human right to make decisions about our own bodies, which is central to reproductive justice and disability justice.** But in our ableist society, disabled people face extra attacks on autonomy and self-determination, such as institutionalization and state-sanctioned sterilization without consent. Disabled people also experience discrimination and additional barriers when seeking health care, including abortion care. **To save lives, remove barriers, and address gaps in sexual and reproductive health, Congresswoman Cori Bush reintroduced the**** _Reproductive Health Care Accessibility Act_****last week.** This legislation would:
* Increase the representation of disabled people in the physician and nursing workforce.
* Provide grant funding to train reproductive health care providers to ensure more competent care for people with disabilities.
* Establish a technical assistance center to provide recommendations and best practices, and more.

********[**Please sign the petition today to respect disabled people’s human rights and support the _Reproductive Health Care Accessibility Act_.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnmQip0KI8h0I2D6ae1eIF_Q3Nro770OWYkDHP24Gl8OmA9_iETDinSRPOX-CYGJXgNp8Q9lRo-M_D6zIrlQBExqV6s_sQPs7NNEAK5ySk37sj07XvSMrHqLPI3L1I0G87Q73ofgHB5HvcZIdKB2jE_EJ4rnuDSHouYK-xqIqzuaWBRci6KQbhr7Xy4Cr94YvjDyWYqjsKCBFjlUR6F3Mu84M_Ygf1Oq8i71Dn5_YjERXVBwcoNllZC93nDSMzSj_L4j5H2VBy7KOfmMbYj60zQQttaggYYSHzpMnVAwLGO7ErFJzc343wAjn1f-PAngmKrtFyzbkHIgk51xCV_nb-G7O6BRpDrYxmIuVCnrHAZA7_7Sk_dBegiR-fM7agTUN6z3CbDS91rfB35-Bv7UMckM/3yc/nk0LhqGfQUqJypItO1ru6w/h0/_yW80s9ZgAJQzAwfJt6WcIRC4SOqTKtOhrUKbGofjh0)**** **[SIGN NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnmQip0KI8h0I2D6ae1eIF_Q3Nro770OWYkDHP24Gl8OmA9_iETDinSRPOX-CYGJXgNp8Q9lRo-M_D6zIrlQBExqV6s_sQPs7NNEAK5ySk37sv1wdd2-qklzS42cl3cu63po49Fu10z5Duz0yIpDVFaGPmUXQXCxgr0XqnVrPXFjcDM0vR-2ulwtZ_3-NrTuqMjvPLtQM1YrNnxfKmXQpyU02hxTX4XaXwacqx-SIZG4veph5xbyXPIrMb_1eziikGAl8-NuEoI013IUiRSbW-3xE72RcZCQbu8n3O_4Iymq68vawWC156kcnR1ZUacxqFmJC3nQViYyPJXv9wcF-58AUHCx7Ej_V7kyJXIkypWII7tyNzVtgYZLEQxuykSlbzZX1d7DsOhsVIhghfxDQh8r/3yc/nk0LhqGfQUqJypItO1ru6w/h1/gPNAs5YYmYtlVU1aCrSJkAnN1vr8QfoO6KKP7gqLTOA) ** Cori is a nurse who has seen the impacts of structural racism and other systemic barriers in health care. | | | It's Marco. Please read this message to the end, but only if you're prepared to handle the reality of our situation. With only about 30% of folks opening these messages, I believe that by opening this, you're someone who can handle it. I know it's hard to tell fact from fiction these days, but I'm going to level with you and tell you the truth.

On top of only about 30% of our friends opening these messages, only about 1% will go the extra mile by donating. Conservatives like me rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to raise money for our cause, so I'm humbly asking you to read this all the way through. If you still think your $1 doesn't matter, then I want to simply thank you for hearing me out.

**Here's the truth...**

The Democrats stopped our Red Wave in 2022, and we need every little bit if we want to fund the programs needed to win in 2024 - and we need it today.

I don't have deep-pocketed billionaires I can call on to hit these goals. I rely on a couple of bucks here and there from hard-working Americans receiving these messages when they can afford it.

**If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit, we would be able to reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' millions raised. I know it's not much, but all I need from you today is the price of a cup of coffee, a candy bar, or a donut.**

Last week, [Russia announced that it was exiting the Black Sea Grain Initiative](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e5550099-536e-412e-9d4c-b4a6bc506588?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a year-old agreement in which Putin's regime guaranteed the safe passage of ships carrying grain exports from Ukraine via the Black Sea. The Kremlin also indicated that it would no longer honor the humanitarian maritime corridor that was part of the UN-led deal.
Over the past year, Ukraine had exported [33 million tons of grain ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8356c6c1-407f-4bfc-ba80-e4e73e3f0fcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)by ships through the Black Sea. The exports provided Ukraine with much needed cash and allowed [food vulnerable nations](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/186545f3-462f-4091-8618-fac0beb25488?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to receive much needed grains. And Ukraine's role in global agriculture is not to be underestimated. [The country has served been a major global producer of corn, wheat, barley, sunflower, and rapeseed and countries around the world depend on Ukrainian imports to meet their domestic needs](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4db55d2c-d232-43ef-8760-42adc1fd3692?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [Egypt, for instance, received 82% of its wheat imports via the Black Sea](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/060b0735-2bc2-4030-bf0d-58323d363958?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from both Russian and Ukrainian sources. It's also worth noting that [Ukraine's fertile land has the ability to feed around 400 million people](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2cf28136-981d-4403-9920-ef3577b16536?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/40ab87bf-bcf2-4f59-8f55-2d349408be2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photo by [Marina Yalanska](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1d1c6dc0-0dd4-4b28-9e57-8d9a1d9008f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on [Unsplash](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cbe73552-c02f-46fd-8aed-04ddcb6797bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In addition to leaving the Black Sea Grain Initiative, Russia also began attacking food infrastructure in Ukraine, targeting a [million tons of grain that were in storage in ports](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4a4c58ee-cdaa-4898-bdd0-82cd7d3e3330?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) awaiting export to Asia and Africa. Putin has claimed the Black Sea deal was bad for Russian farmers and they've lost billions while Ukrainian farmers have benefitted. [He's vowed to return to the deal if the West readmits Russia's state agriculture bank to the SWIFT financial system](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4a4c58ee-cdaa-4898-bdd0-82cd7d3e3330?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), among other demands.
Russia's recent attacks on grain infrastructure are an acceleration of a long-running effort to undermine Ukraine's agriculture economy. [Prior to the war, agriculture represented 11% of Ukraine's GDP, ~15% of jobs, and around 40% of Ukraine's exports by value](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9db86221-80e7-419d-8b59-fa2ba63a4510?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Since the war began, Russia [has mined Ukrainian farms](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/851551e8-863a-4ad6-bf0d-32e670fd3369?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with the US Embassy in Luxembourg noting that "[thirty percent of Ukraine's agricultural land is either occupied by Russian military forces or unsafe](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/17dddb5e-2969-46ba-b899-3b9b33d2ac46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." In addition to disrupting farming, the war has also threatened fertilizer markets, specifically potash. [Russia and Belarus combined are responsible for approximately 40% of global potash production](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c7a21a30-cb24-489c-9dae-581c07c744fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..36Uv6XCWqYUrlM1jGjUPjX2_IIfTUIZFl_7_lb_EXo4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=135528251)
#### Exploring the Russia-China Connection
As this food fight intensifies, it's worth taking a step back to explore the Russia-China connection. I've been asked many times if I think the Russian invasion of Ukraine was a coordinated distraction to enable China to attack Taiwan. While I don't have any unique insight, here are some facts worth considering.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dd187d7f-d1f5-4cfd-8950-8c243a40a3a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photo: Wikimedia Commons
A mere weeks before Russia invaded Ukraine, Russian President Vladimir Putin cozied up to Xi Jinping at the Beijing Olympics. Might Putin have telegraphed his intentions? Did he seek China's blessing? Possibly. But a far more concrete output from that meeting was [a joint statement made by the two of them](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/48e7eac9-6fdb-4932-8a5f-c61582247f5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about a friendship with no bounds. I encourage you to read the statement, and note their agreement on working together to strengthen multilateral institutions ([something I commented on last week](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/802a2e92-18f8-4594-98a3-b81762b90514?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) as well as to protect internal affairs from external influence. Consider the following excerpt (emphasis added):
> _Russia and China stand against attempts by **external forces to undermine security and stability in their common adjacent regions**, intend to counter interference by outside forces in the internal affairs of sovereign countries under any pretext, oppose colour revolutions, and will increase cooperation in the aforementioned areas._
It's also worth noting, that the statement was issued on February 4, 2022. Less than two months later, Russia began its war in Ukraine. Here's another excerpt (emphasis added):
> _**Friendship between the two States has no limits**, there are **no "forbidden" areas of cooperation**, strengthening of bilateral strategic cooperation is neither aimed against third countries nor affected by the changing international environment and circumstantial changes in third countries._
Again, it's impossible to know if the Ukraine war is part of a coordinated plan that includes China invading Taiwan, but it's hard to believe that Xi was not aware of, and implicitly approved of, Putin's invasion of Ukraine. Relatedly, there's another statement made by Putin that's worth connecting to this discussion. [On July 12, 2021, Vladimir Putin posted "On the Historical Unity of Russians and Ukrainians."](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e364004f-cfa1-43a1-abf7-41a75b0cb865?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Could Russia and China be equating Ukraine and Taiwan? Just as China thinks of Taiwan as a breakaway province, might Russia think similarly about Ukraine? Again, hard to know for sure, but the idea gains believability when you factor in the "internal affairs" language that both Putin and Xi are using in their public statements.

#### The Food Fight and US-China War
Scenes of social unrest driven by famine in the 1950s and 1960s remain firmly etched in many Chinese leaders' minds. As the country's population has boomed, so too have the government's concerns about instability. Further, as Chinese citizens have earned more money, they've included more meat in their diets. And because livestock must also eat, the demand for grains has skyrocketed.
This has sent the Middle Kingdom on a global quest to secure food. Interestingly, [China owns around 10% of Ukraine's arable farmland](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8b5d6b89-4b01-460d-88da-549b8cf8b3ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), something it started acquiring in 2013. Also in 2013, Hong Kong company WH Group purchased Smithfield Foods, America's leading producer of pigs and pork products. [Because Smithfield owned around 146,000 acres, the acquisition made WH Group one of the largest foreign owners of American farmland](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/31693a8c-6bf8-4a71-b1b8-cea9fb72ed05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And of course, there's Africa, where China has been on a consistent buying spree. China [secured the rights to farm 100,000 hectares in the Democratic Republic of Congo, they're producing and exporting beef in Zimbabwe](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6549f68f-4620-4696-adb4-a7d34fb9b7ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and they have had "[Chinese Friendship Farms](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a0c57fe1-3bad-4096-9da1-aa4960bc0bfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" all over the continent.
In many countries, political efforts to block these "land grabs" are gaining momentum. Within the United States, for example, several states have banned the purchase of farmland by Chinese citizens or corporations linked to the Chinese Communist Party. As noted in the video below, American farmland is now a battleground in the fight with China.
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/638295ff-e555-4ffb-a88a-3fbf2090e217?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It's time to acknowledge the geostrategic value of agricultural resources. Those countries with fertile land, abundant water, or supplies of critical inputs (such as fertilizer ingredients like potash or phosphate) are going to gain in power over those that are dependent upon them.
Just as the American ecosystem is vulnerable with respect to the supply of many pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and rare earth metals, so too is the Chinese ecosystem vulnerable with respect to food.
As I have repeatedly noted, [I believe the world is bifurcating into two global ecosystems, one led by China and the other by Western nations](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/634301a9-2b84-478c-95b9-defd330e3f92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And while these two global economies will be mostly self-contained, there are notable shortages within each that will create strategic risks and opportunities. Just as the American ecosystem is vulnerable with respect to the supply of many pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and rare earth metals, so too is the Chinese ecosystem vulnerable with respect to food. China's leaders know this. Could the Russian invasion of Ukraine be a front in the US-China war? Is Russia merely a pawn being moved by Beijing to help secure agricultural resources? Is access to Ukraine's fertile black earth the ultimate aim of China's "friendship" with Russia? While it's impossible to answer these questions, one thing is certain: a global food fight is underway.

| | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Sun Reader,
---
| | In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Peter,
Today is the last day of July, which also means it is **our last chance to meet our $90,000 fundraising goal for the month.**
Before asking you to make a contribution before tonight’s midnight deadline, we want to show you what we are seeing on our end.
This is what our fundraising looks like right now:
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/136249?refcode=em20230731-30159&t=1&akid=30159%2E1203867%2E1AnSBV)
The good news is we’re just under $2,000 from meeting our goal this month! If enough people reading this email chip in, we’ll reach our goal in no time: [**click here to contribute $3 right now.**](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/136249?refcode=em20230731-30159&t=2&akid=30159%2E1203867%2E1AnSBV)
But now, we want to show you where we were at this time last year:
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/136243?refcode=em20230731-30159&t=3&akid=30159%2E1203867%2E1AnSBV)
The bad news is, we’re a far cry from where we were fundraising-wise in July 2022. We are not mincing our words when we tell you that we need a major influx of donations to amp up our momentum back to where it was last year.
[**If you believe in our cause for a more progressive future and are able to chip in, please consider making a $3 contribution right now.**](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/136249?refcode=em20230731-30159&t=4&akid=30159%2E1203867%2E1AnSBV)

Thank you for being in this fight with us,
Team JD
Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=24&akid=30159%2E1203867%2E1AnSBV) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. body:
Hi Peter,
It's Hung Cao, and I want to level with you.
Sending emails like this isn't something I enjoy. And you know what? I'm willing to bet you're just as tired of receiving them from every single politician in Washington. Trust me, my inbox is overflowing, and I'm as fed up with them as you are.
So here's the deal: I won't beg you for money or resort to flashy tactics. Instead, I'm going to lay it all out on the table and be completely upfront with you.
When it all comes down to it, people from every corner of our nation will scrutinize the amount of money we've raised during this crucial first month since I announced my campaign. We have an opportunity to make a resounding impact, and we need to seize the moment.
As I mentioned before, I don't like sending these emails and texts, but can you guess what I do love doing?
I LOVE having the chance to prove all the doubters wrong--the ones who laugh at me for having hope in America, who question our ability to triumph over an incumbent Democrat, and those who doubt I can turn this blue state into a red one.
To them, I say: Bring it on.
I've always told you that I don't shy away from a fight, and I mean it.
If you're someone who shares that spirit and refuses to back down, join me in the trenches of this new mission, and let's show the world what we're truly capable of.
I won't pretend it'll be easy, but by joining forces, we'll send a resounding message that true change starts from the ground up. We'll prove that ordinary people united by a common purpose can defy the odds and create a future where our voices are heard.
So, Peter, if you're as determined as I am, let's rise above the noise. Let's show them what we're made of.

Thank you for standing shoulder-to-shoulder with me in the battle to save this great Nation. Together, we'll prove that passion, grit, and grassroots support can turn the tide in our state and our country.
-Hung
